The Community You Will Join: 

Hotels represent one of Airbnb's most exciting growth frontiers,  bringing professional hospitality partners onto the platform and making it possible for guests to choose Airbnb for every kind of trip. By ensuring a robust and exceptional hotel supply, the Revenue Operations team plays a critical role in shaping Airbnb's future and delivering on its mission to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere.

The Revenue Operations team partners across the company to build world-class Sales, Onboarding, and Account Management capabilities. We support partners across the full journey –  from identifying and acquiring the right supply in the right markets, to seamless onboarding and integration, to the tools, programs, and insights that help partners grow and succeed on our platform. We own critical growth levers that ladder directly into business goals, and we build the central infrastructure that powers in-market execution for field teams worldwide.

The Difference You Will Make:

Optimized hotel supply is one of the most important drivers of Hotels performance at Airbnb, and this role sits at the center of that effort. As Senior Sales Operations Lead, Hotels Optimization, you will own the global operations strategy for the supply optimization program, partnering with Account Management, Product, Marketing, and Analytics to help hotels price competitively, adopt discounts and programs, and use every available lever to grow.

You will be the global subject matter expert on hotel optimization levers. You will translate data into decisions and make sure Account Management teams have the insights, targets, tools, and playbooks to drive results in their markets. You will report to the Director of Enterprise Operations, Hotels.

A Typical Day: 

Sales Operations & Revenue Strategy

  • Global Optimization Strategy: Define and execute the operating strategy for the supply optimization program, aligning regional priorities with global goals and driving a consistent, high-performing approach across markets.
  • Lever Ownership: Own the optimization lever framework, including pricing competitiveness, discount adoption, and other hotel-facing levers. Advise leadership and regional teams on which levers to activate for specific markets, segments, and hotel types.
  • Account Management Operations: Be the operational partner to Account Management teams. Build the segmentation, prioritization, reporting, and playbooks that help account managers focus on the right hotels and the right actions.
  • Program Performance & Adoption: Track program health end to end, from hotel eligibility through adoption and realized impact. Identify drop-off points and drive cross-functional fixes that improve adoption, retention, and results.
  • Goal Setting, Forecasting & Capacity: Translate business targets into regional and account-level goals for optimization. Lead forecasting and capacity planning so Account Management and vendor partners are resourced and on track.
  • Incentives & Performance Management: Partner with Finance and leadership to design and evaluate incentive and performance programs for account management teams, ensuring they reward the right behaviors across regions.
  • Analysis, Modeling & Insights: Build your own models and frameworks to size opportunities, measure lever impact, run scenarios, and test hypotheses. Go beyond existing reporting to produce original analysis, and turn it into clear recommendations that shape leadership decisions and resource allocation.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary global point of contact for hotel optimization operations, ensuring alignment, data integrity, and clear communication across sales, account management, product, marketing, analytics, and finance.

Your Expertise:

  • 12+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, account management operations, or a related field, ideally in a high-growth, global environment. Hospitality, OTA, or marketplace experience required.
  • Proven ability to run and improve a complex, multi-stage program with measurable impact on adoption, revenue, or supply quality.
  • Working knowledge of hotel pricing and revenue management concepts (rate strategy, rate plans, promotions, parity, distribution channel performance) and how they connect to marketplace outcomes.
  • Strong strategic and analytical skills, with the ability to turn complex performance data into clear insights that drive decisions.
  • Experience with goal setting, forecasting, capacity planning, and incentive or performance programs.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills across account management, product, marketing, tech, analytics, and finance.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to and influence senior leadership.
  • Strong modeling skills: comfortable building analyses from scratch. Proficiency in Excel and SQL required; BI tools (Tableau, Looker) a plus.
  • Proficiency in CRM and performance management systems (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Experience working in or with global, matrixed organizations and navigating regional differences in go-to-market approaches.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and executional level — you can set the vision and get into the details to make it happen.

descriptionHtml:

The Community You Will Join: 

Join our world-class Global Foundation Recruiting team, renowned for its dedication to excellence and innovation in talent acquisition. We are a dynamic, fun and passionate group, committed to building a diverse and high-performing workforce that propels our mission forward. As we navigate the ever-evolving landscape of our business, we pride ourselves on our collaborative approach, working closely with leaders globally to shape their hiring strategies.

Our team is focused on attracting the best talent of this generation, ensuring that we not only meet our strategic goals but also foster an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive, have fun and support each other. Together, we are setting the standard for recruiting excellence at Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

Your main responsibility will be to successfully bring searches to fruition and deliver exceptional experiences for candidates and hiring managers across our CBO function, with additional support for hiring across our corporate functions. Our team takes a consultative approach, working closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions. Dedicated to sourcing and hiring top talent in the market, we ensure that every individual interacting with Airbnb's recruitment process feels valued and supported.

A Typical Day: 

  • Manage and drive a full-cycle recruitment process including sourcing, screening, interview, feedback and offers for all levels of candidates from entry to senior level — across our CBO function (sales, business development, partnerships and other commercial/revenue-generating roles) and our corporate functions (such as Finance, Legal, People, Marketing and Communications).

The Airbnb Hotels organization, which includes HotelTonight, is a fun, entrepreneurial, start-up team where you can have outsized impact. Simplicity is at the core of our products. We pride ourselves on delivering the smoothest and most intuitive hotel booking experience. For hotels, we make it easy to drive incremental bookings so they can focus on the craft of hosting. We aspire to facilitate hotel discovery and serendipity at scale, benefitting guests and hotel partners.

Focusing on these responsibilities, you will build the Hotel category’s market presence in your assigned territory and collaborate with other teams as the local in-market expert. This includes partnering, strategizing, and running daily operations directly with hotels and ensuring that HotelTonight and Airbnb always have the best inventory and deals available for our guests.

Senior Market Managers are self-starters, versed in operating autonomously, and acting as mentors to fellow colleagues. You will promote best practice sharing, team collaboration, and strategic thinking through leading by example. 

You will help resolve challenges and ensure that partners feel valued and supported by our platforms. title: Senior Manager, Technical Brand & Content
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb’s mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. As we work to achieve that mission, our cross functional Tech Operations and Programs team helps enable Tech organizations to execute and deliver on high impact programs and initiatives. 

The Difference You Will Make:

You will decide what the engineering world knows about Airbnb.

  • Our engineers solve hard problems at scale across infrastructure, data, and applied AI — and they write about that work well. Almost none of the engineers we'd most like to hire have ever seen it.
  • You'll change that, and the change is measurable. A year in, senior candidates should arrive already able to describe our technical work accurately, because they found it before we found them. Our engineers should be recognised names in their fields rather than anonymous authors. Airbnb should be the source people cite on at least one technical domain. And the strongest engineers in the market should have a reason to choose us that has nothing to do with the offer.
  • That is a rare kind of impact for this discipline. Most tech brand roles are asked to manufacture credibility that isn't there. Here the engineering is genuinely strong and already documented — the gap is that it doesn't travel. You'd be building the function that closes it, with real autonomy, very little inherited process, and direct access to engineering leaders and our CTO.

A Typical Day:

  • Own the editorial engine. Run the Airbnb Tech Blog end to end: sourcing topics from teams, coaching engineer-authors, editing to a high bar, and moving posts through legal, security and comms review without letting them stall. Set and hold a publishing rhythm the org can rely on.
  • Find the cross-team narratives. Our biggest gap is that individually strong posts never add up to a story. You'll work across orgs to identify the themes that connect work from multiple teams, and publish them as connected sets — while each domain keeps publishing in depth for its own specialists.
  • Build our voices. Help our engineers and technical leaders develop genuine public presence: bylines, talks, speaker coaching, and a pipeline of new voices. This includes partnering closely with our CTO to establish his public technical presence.
  • Own distribution. Establish our canonical home on an Airbnb-owned domain, stand up the surfaces we're missing including video, and decide what our social channels are for. Publishing well and distributing poorly is the pattern we're here to break.
  • Run our external presence. Set conference and event strategy — where we speak, where we sponsor, where we skip — and manage what we host ourselves. Own our academic collaborations and technical media relationships, and the budget and vendors behind all of it.
  • Steward our open source presence. Make sure what Airbnb claims publicly is accurate and actually maintained, and that the projects carrying our name reflect how we want to be seen.
  • Prove it works. Partner with Talent Acquisition to connect this work to hiring outcomes — inbound share of the senior pipeline, offer acceptance at staff level and above in ML and infrastructure — and be honest about what is and isn't attributable.

Your Expertise:

  • Substantial experience in technical content, developer relations, engineering communications or technical editorial — including time spent working directly with engineers, not adjacent to them.
  • Technical fluency. You don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own in a systems design conversation, read a design doc, and judge whether a draft post says anything real. Credibility with staff engineers is the difference between this role working and not working.
  • Editorial judgment and hands-on craft. You can edit an engineer's draft into something sharper without flattening their voice, and you know the difference between a post that teaches something and one that announces something.
  • Influence without authority. Nothing you need is owned by you. You've built systems and incentives that got busy senior people to produce, rather than relying on persistence.
  • Program discipline. You've owned events, budgets and vendors end to end, and you're comfortable with the unglamorous half of the job.
  • Measurement literacy. You connect brand work to funnel outcomes, and you're straight about the limits of attribution rather than reaching for impressions.
  • Judgment on risk. You've navigated legal and security review, and you know what shouldn't be published as well as what should.

Nice to have

  • Experience migrating a technical publication between platforms, including the SEO and redirect work.
  • Experience running or fixing an open source program.
  • Experience helping a senior executive build a public technical presence.
  • Familiarity with AI and ML engineering topics, and with academic or research communications.
  • Video or multi-format content experience.

descriptionHtml:

The Community You Will Join: 

The Principal, Strategic Finance & Analytics, Incubations role will partner closely with business, product, and analytics leaders across Luxe, Monthly Stays, and Airbnb for Business. This role will directly support the investment decisions behind Airbnb's fastest growing emerging businesses.

We sit at the intersection of finance, strategy, and the business, partnering directly with leaders to decide where Airbnb invests, how we grow, and what we do next. We expect every member of the team to bring a CFO mindset to budget management, producing actionable insights, owning our performance story, and supporting day-to-day execution.

Why join us:

  • A seat at the table. We're advisors, not just analysts. Our work shapes real decisions, not just decks.
  • A steep learning curve. Small, lean teams and a focus on internal mobility means broad exposure across product and business areas.

If you like ambiguity, moving fast, and building the answer instead of just reporting it, you'll fit right in.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Principal in Strategic Finance & Analytics supporting Luxe, Monthly Stays, and Airbnb for Business, you will be highly visible and partner with senior leaders across each business to accelerate their path to scale. You will become the subject matter expert on the economics of these businesses, including how demand and supply are acquired, what they cost, and what they return. You will bring a strong point of view on where we should be investing more, where we should be investing differently, and what we need to prove before we invest at all.

This role requires a strong commercial mindset, with the ability to size opportunities, evaluate returns, and translate performance and funnel insight into clear business implications and strategic recommendations for senior leadership. Because these are incubation businesses, the analytical foundation often does not yet exist, so you will build it. The ideal candidate relishes the opportunity to roll up their sleeves, and is a self-starter comfortable embracing the adventure of a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

A Typical Day: 

  • Investment Decision Support: Build the business cases behind major investment decisions across Luxe, Monthly Stays, and Airbnb for Business. Size the opportunity, model the returns, and frame the tradeoffs so leadership can decide where to place bets and how large those bets should be
  • Performance Management: Own end to end performance management for the incubation portfolio, including forecasting, goal and OKR setting, and executive reporting. Build scalable reporting frameworks that connect early signals to revenue and long term value
  • Full Funnel Analytics: Track and analyze full funnel performance across demand and supply for each business. Identify where the funnel leaks, why, and what it is worth to fix
  • Unit Economics and Scalability: Establish and pressure test the unit economics of each business. Determine which parts of the model improve with scale, which do not, and what needs to be true for these businesses to become material contributors
  • Capital Allocation Across the Portfolio: Assess how investment is allocated across the incubation businesses relative to their potential. Recommend reallocation where returns and readiness diverge from where capital is going today
  • Presentations to Leadership: Synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior leadership. Influence cross functional stakeholders to drive alignment on high impact investment and operating decisions

Your Expertise:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience. Ideally, you have demonstrated relevant experience in an analytical role such as strategic finance, strategy/management consulting, investment banking, financial planning and analysis, business operations, or private equity
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with the ability to independently extract, analyze, and synthesize data
  • Superb financial modeling skills and extensive experience conducting quantitative and qualitative financial analysis
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into decisions
  • Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
  • High ownership mindset with strong judgment and attention to detail
  • Experience evaluating growth strategies, ROI/efficiency returns, and the scalability of new business models is a big plus

descriptionHtml:

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

The Airbnb Hotels organization, which includes HotelTonight, is a fun, entrepreneurial, start-up team where you can have outsized impact. Simplicity is at the core of our products. We pride ourselves on delivering the smoothest and most intuitive hotel booking experience. For hotels, we make it easy to drive incremental bookings so they can focus on the craft of hosting. We aspire to facilitate hotel discovery and serendipity at scale, benefitting guests and hotel partners.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Market Manager, your role will entail ensuring the health and expansion of our supply in Charleston and Myrtle Beach, SC. This will involve managing Hotels, optimizing their set-up via discounts, availability and other levers. Your focus will be to enhance Airbnb's market presence in your designated region through collaboration with other teams, leveraging your expertise on the local market. With a deep understanding of Airbnb's mission and values, you will oversee all aspects of the hotel’s  success on HotelTonight and Airbnb. This includes developing tiering and account management strategies, converting Hotel leads, and managing relationships with strategic partners, as well as internal stakeholders. You will also be tasked with developing and refining scalable, localized supply management strategies for both established, competitive markets and emerging, untapped markets, aiming to secure our long-term success in these regions.

A Typical Day: 

  • Build, manage and expand partner relationships within your territory, aiming to surpass quarterly sales targets with Hotels.
  • Conduct regular optimization calls and business reviews with partners to develop strong, enduring partnerships providing exceptional, timely service to hosts, including in-person support as needed.
  • Implement strategies to effectively manage and optimize the long tail of thousands of Hotels in your region.
  • Educate clients on all significant product updates and cascade feedback on product and public policy to the relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Leverage data to identify and pursue strategic growth opportunities, demonstrating an ability to navigate operational complexities and efficiently allocate resources.
  • Use an entrepreneurial approach to develop and implement unique engagement projects, fostering innovation within your territory.
  • Work cross-functionally with teams such as product, communications, public policy, legal, tax and customer support to ensure Airbnb's long-term market success.
  • Acquire comprehensive knowledge of local market trends to inform both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Understand the technical aspects of software partnerships to offer comprehensive support, ensuring a seamless experience for hosts and guests.
  • Represent Airbnb in external meetings with Hotels and at industry conferences in your market, solidifying the brand's presence and commitment.

Your Expertise:

  • 6+ years of experience in new sales, account management, and partner support, showcasing a deep understanding and capability in fostering business relationships.
  • 2+ years of tech/travel industry experience is a plus, highlighting the value of sector-specific knowledge.
  • Proven track record of being able to effectively work a book of business, demonstrating expertise in nurturing and converting potential opportunities.
  • Proficient quantitative skills and proven ability to interpret and apply data throughout your day-to-day work, emphasizing the importance of data-driven decision-making.
  • The ability to work at both strategic and tactical levels, with a proven track record to execute in ambiguous environments, highlighting adaptability and strategic foresight.
  • Proven experience working cross-functionally, ensuring the ability to collaborate effectively with various teams to drive collective success.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to communicate effectively with clients via phone, email, and in-person, underscoring the importance of strong interpersonal skills.
  • Charismatic self-starter who is resourceful and self-sufficient, paired with strong time management and prioritization skills, showcasing the initiative and organizational capabilities required for the role.
  • Highly proficient in using CRM software, specifically in working with leads, opportunities, and other core objects - Salesforce experience is a plus, indicating the technical tools proficiency needed for effective relationship management.
  • Based in Charleston or Myrtle Beach, SC and must be willing to regularly travel to your assigned territory. Typical expectation would be once every 4 to 6 weeks.

descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Difference You Will Make:

Airbnb is seeking a Delivery Excellence Manager to join our Community Support organization and lead a team of Team Specialists within Premium Support. This is a new, full-time people manager position based in Canada East - Remote. You will manage a team of 7-8 Team Specialists across Canada and EMEA, coaching and developing them across three areas of work: subject matter expertise, operations and administration, and projects. 

You will also help the team move from a small, self-organizing group to a larger, regionalized operation with more formal systems and processes, including how work is requested, assigned and tracked.

You will need hands-on people management experience (coaching, performance management and developing team members), a background in customer service operations, an understanding of hospitality and premium support, and active use of AI tools in your day-to-day work. Experience leading a team through change is essential. Structured project management and data/reporting experience are key to success in this role.

A Typical Day: 

Lead the team's subject matter expertise (SME) work as the frontline for Premium Support

  • Build and nurture an engaged, diverse team of seven to eight Team Specialists across Canada and EMEA.
  • Coach and uplevel Team Specialists, supporting and challenging them to meet and exceed expectations.
  • Mentor Team Specialists into larger project management initiatives. Create development paths and stretch assignments that take them from owning small work streams to leading cross-functional projects.
  • Identify and implement workflow improvements, maintain and improve Slack-based processes, and bring insights back to leadership  

Run the team's operations and administration work in partnership with Workforce Planning 

  • Oversee scheduling, including maintaining NICE and related spreadsheets and managing the scheduling inbox
  • Set and track targets for the quality, volume and turnaround of consult output, making sure the team provides the right types of consults.
  • Lead the team’s subject matter expertise (SME) work as the frontline for Premium Support, overseeing consults and refresher sessions.
  • Build a systematic, capacity-based approach to work intake and distribution in place of informal volunteering, and balance workloads fairly across the team.
  • Run the team’s operations and administration work in partnership with Workforce Planning, including scheduling, NICE and related spreadsheets, and the scheduling inbox.
  • Identify and implement workflow improvements, and maintain and improve Slack-based processes.

Drive projects that scale operations and bring performance insights to Premium Support leaders 

  • Lead and coach Team Specialists to run fully structured projects, including process design, communications, change management plans and success tracking 
  • Drive automation and scaling initiatives, including AI-enabled tools that replace manual, spreadsheet-based processes
  • Bring performance insights from consult and admin work to Premium Support managers and leaders to support coaching and performance improvement

Build and nurture an engaged & diverse team across Canada and EMEA

  • Own and manage end-to-end people strategy and operations. This includes hiring, driving onboarding, talent development, and people engagement/wellness/morale

  • Lead the team through change as it moves from small, self-organized ways of working to more formal, regionalized systems and processes
  • Keep up with day-to-day management, including flexing your schedule to overlap with team members in EMEA when needed

  • Hospitality or premium tier support knowledge, with a clear sense of what good looks like in supporting frontline teams

  • Ability to “speak the language” of various stakeholders within the organization (from engineers to product to process improvement to analytics) with a capacity to adapt communication to frontline teams or executive leadership 
  • Has worked in global teams at scale in fast paced environments where ambiguity & changes are the norm rather than the exception
  • Excellent communication skills for collaborating with stakeholders and ensuring transparency within the team
  • Ability to formalize documents & decks to either work cross-functionally or present to senior leadership or vast audiences 
  • Ability to drive strategic initiatives within the organization exercising deep influential skills & stakeholder management 
  • Strong work ethic, proactive, exhibits positivity, professionalism, confidentiality and good judgment
  • Comfort with conflict, giving and receiving feedback, and handling employee/Talent issues
  • Cultural competency and a strong commitment to fostering diversity and inclusion within the team
  • Ability to work weekend days and on-call required, with flexibility to adjust your hours to overlap with team members in EMEA
  • Nice to have: structured project management (PMO) experience, including process documentation and scaling operations; experience with Airtable or similar tools; familiarity with NICE or similar workforce management tools; and experience working with EMEA teams or managing across time zones

This position is Canada - Remote East Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. title: Gestionnaire, Excellence de la prestation de services
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Airbnb a pris le jour en 2007 lorsque deux Hôtes ont accueilli trois invités dans leur maison de San Francisco, et compte depuis lors plus de 4 millions d'Hôtes qui ont accueilli plus d'un milliard d'invités dans presque tous les pays du monde. Chaque jour, les Hôtes proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux invités de se connecter de manière plus authentique aux communautés.

La différence que vous ferez :

Airbnb est à la recherche d'un ou d'une gestionnaire, Excellence de la prestation de services, pour se joindre à son organisation Soutien à la communauté et diriger une équipe de spécialistes d'équipe au sein du Soutien Premium. Il s'agit d'un nouveau poste de gestion de personnel à temps plein, basé dans l'Est du Canada, en télétravail. Vous gérerez une équipe de 7 ou 8 spécialistes d'équipe répartis au Canada et dans la région EMEA (Europe, Moyen-Orient et Afrique), et vous les encadrerez et favoriserez leur développement dans trois domaines de travail : l'expertise en la matière, les opérations et l'administration, ainsi que les projets.

Vous aiderez également l'équipe à passer d'un petit groupe autogéré à une structure régionalisée de plus grande envergure, dotée de systèmes et de processus plus formels, notamment pour ce qui est de la façon dont le travail est demandé, attribué et suivi.

Vous devrez posséder une expérience concrète de la gestion de personnel (encadrement, gestion du rendement et perfectionnement des membres de l'équipe), une expérience du domaine des opérations du service à la clientèle, une bonne compréhension de l'hospitalité et du soutien Premium, ainsi qu'une utilisation active des outils d'IA dans votre travail quotidien. L'expérience de la direction d'une équipe en période de changement est essentielle. Une expérience en gestion de projet structurée ainsi qu'en analyse de données et en production de rapports est un atout majeur pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Une journée typique : 

Diriger le travail d'expertise en la matière (EM) de l'équipe, à titre de première ligne du Soutien Premium

  • Bâtir et faire grandir une équipe mobilisée et diversifiée de sept ou huit spécialistes d'équipe au Canada et dans la région EMEA.
  • Encadrer les spécialistes d'équipe et rehausser leurs compétences, en les soutenant et en les stimulant afin qu'ils atteignent et dépassent les attentes.
  • Guider les spécialistes d'équipe vers des initiatives de gestion de projet de plus grande envergure. Créer des parcours de développement et des affectations de perfectionnement qui les mènent de la responsabilité de petits volets de travail à la direction de projets interfonctionnels.
  • Cerner et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de flux de travail, maintenir et améliorer les processus reposant sur Slack, et transmettre les constats à la direction.

Gérer le travail d'opérations et d'administration de l'équipe en partenariat avec la Planification de la main-d'œuvre

  • Superviser la planification des horaires, y compris la tenue à jour de NICE et des feuilles de calcul connexes, ainsi que la gestion de la boîte de courriel des horaires.
  • Établir et suivre des cibles pour la qualité, le volume et les délais de traitement des consultations, en s'assurant que l'équipe offre les bons types de consultations.
  • Diriger le travail d'expertise en la matière (EM) de l'équipe, à titre de première ligne du Soutien Premium, en supervisant les consultations et les séances de mise à niveau.
  • Mettre en place une approche systématique, fondée sur la capacité, pour la prise en charge et la répartition du travail, en remplacement du bénévolat informel, et répartir équitablement les charges de travail au sein de l'équipe.
  • Gérer le travail d'opérations et d'administration de l'équipe en partenariat avec la Planification de la main-d'œuvre, y compris la planification des horaires, NICE et les feuilles de calcul connexes, ainsi que la boîte de courriel des horaires.
  • Cerner et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de flux de travail, et maintenir et améliorer les processus reposant sur Slack.

Mener des projets qui permettent de faire évoluer les opérations et transmettre des constats sur le rendement aux leaders du Soutien Premium

  • Diriger et encadrer les spécialistes d'équipe pour qu'ils mènent des projets entièrement structurés, y compris la conception des processus, les communications, les plans de gestion du changement et le suivi des résultats.
  • Piloter des initiatives d'automatisation et de mise à l'échelle, notamment des outils dotés d'IA qui remplacent les processus manuels reposant sur des feuilles de calcul.
  • Transmettre aux gestionnaires et aux leaders du Soutien Premium les constats sur le rendement tirés du travail de consultation et d'administration, afin d'appuyer l'encadrement et l'amélioration du rendement.

Bâtir et faire grandir une équipe mobilisée et diversifiée au Canada et dans la région EMEA

  • Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie et des opérations liées aux personnes, de bout en bout. Cela comprend l'embauche, l'intégration, le développement des talents, ainsi que la mobilisation, le bien-être et le moral de l'équipe.
  • Encadrer les spécialistes d'équipe et rehausser leurs compétences, en les soutenant et en les stimulant afin qu'ils atteignent et dépassent les attentes.
  • Mettre en place une approche systématique, fondée sur la capacité, pour la prise en charge et la répartition du travail, en remplacement du bénévolat informel, et répartir équitablement les charges de travail au sein de l'équipe.
  • Accompagner l'équipe dans le changement, alors qu'elle passe de modes de travail autogérés à petite échelle à des systèmes et des processus plus formels et régionalisés.
  • Assurer la gestion courante, y compris en adaptant votre horaire pour chevaucher celui des membres de l'équipe de la région EMEA au besoin.

Votre expertise :

  • Au moins 8 ans d'expérience progressive dans les opérations de centre de contact ou de service à la clientèle, avec des responsabilités croissantes en matière de stratégie et d'optimisation des opérations, et une participation à des programmes axés sur les données et la technologie.
  • Expérience directe de la gestion de personnel, y compris l'encadrement, la gestion du rendement et le perfectionnement des membres de l'équipe.
  • Baccalauréat exigé; MBA ou maîtrise équivalente fortement privilégié.
  • Expérience des opérations du service à la clientèle, avec une compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement des agents et des gestionnaires à grande échelle et de la façon de diriger efficacement les opérations.
  • Connaissance de l'hospitalité ou du soutien de niveau Premium, avec une idée claire de ce qui définit un bon soutien aux équipes de première ligne.
  • Aisance avec l'IA : utilisation active d'outils d'IA dans votre travail quotidien et à l'aise de diriger une équipe qui adopte rapidement l'IA dans ses flux de travail.
  • Compétences en gestion du changement, avec la capacité d'accompagner une équipe dans la transition de modes de travail informels vers des modes de travail structurés.
  • Expérience de la traduction d'objectifs et de stratégies de haut niveau en mesures concrètes et réalisables pour vos équipes.
  • Capacité de « parler le langage » des différentes parties prenantes de l'organisation (de l'ingénierie au produit, en passant par l'amélioration des processus et l'analytique), et d'adapter votre communication aux équipes de première ligne comme à la haute direction.
  • Expérience de travail au sein d'équipes mondiales à grande échelle, dans des environnements en constante évolution où l'ambiguïté et le changement sont la norme plutôt que l'exception.
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication pour collaborer avec les parties prenantes et assurer la transparence au sein de l'équipe.
  • Capacité de structurer des documents et des présentations pour travailler de façon interfonctionnelle, ou pour les présenter à la haute direction ou à un vaste public.
  • Capacité de mener des initiatives stratégiques au sein de l'organisation, en faisant preuve d'une grande force d'influence et d'un excellent sens de la gestion des parties prenantes.
  • Solide éthique de travail, proactivité, positivisme, professionnalisme, sens de la confidentialité et bon jugement.
  • Aisance à gérer les conflits, à donner et à recevoir de la rétroaction, et à traiter les enjeux liés aux employés et aux talents.
  • Compétence culturelle et engagement ferme à favoriser la diversité et l'inclusion au sein de l'équipe.
  • Capacité de travailler les fins de semaine et d'assurer des quarts de garde (exigence du poste), avec la souplesse nécessaire pour adapter vos heures afin de chevaucher celles des membres de l'équipe de la région EMEA.
  • Atouts : expérience en gestion de projet structurée (bureau de gestion de projets, ou PMO), y compris la documentation des processus et la mise à l'échelle des opérations; expérience avec Airtable ou des outils semblables; connaissance de NICE ou d'outils semblables de gestion de la main-d'œuvre; expérience de travail avec des équipes de la région EMEA ou de gestion à travers plusieurs fuseaux horaires.

Votre emplacement :

Ce poste est offert au Canada, en télétravail – Est. Il comprend la supervision d'employés au Canada et dans la région EMEA; vous devrez donc adapter votre horaire pour chevaucher celui des membres de l'équipe de la région EMEA au besoin. Le poste peut occasionnellement exiger de travailler dans un bureau d'Airbnb ou de participer à des rencontres hors site, selon ce qui est convenu avec votre gestionnaire. Bien que le poste soit admissible au télétravail, vous devez résider dans une province où Airbnb Canada, Inc. possède une entité enregistrée. Nous pouvons actuellement embaucher dans les provinces suivantes : Alberta, Ontario, Colombie-Britannique, Québec et Saskatchewan. Cette liste évolue continuellement; veuillez donc vérifier auprès de votre recruteur ou recruteuse les provinces à partir desquelles vous pouvez travailler.

Airbnb s'engage à travailler avec le vivier de talents le plus large possible. Nous pensons que la diversité des idées favorise l’innovation et l’engagement, et nous permet d’attirer des personnes créatives et de développer les meilleurs produits, services et solutions. Si vous êtes un candidat handicapé et avez besoin d'aménagements raisonnables pour soumettre une candidature, veuillez nous contacter à l'adresse : raisonnableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Veuillez inclure votre nom complet, le poste pour lequel vous postulez et les aménagements nécessaires pour vous aider dans le processus de recrutement.

title: Market Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

The Airbnb Hotels organization, which includes HotelTonight, is a fun, entrepreneurial, start-up team where you can have outsized impact. Simplicity is at the core of our products. We pride ourselves on delivering the smoothest and most intuitive hotel booking experience. For hotels, we make it easy to drive incremental bookings so they can focus on the craft of hosting. We aspire to facilitate hotel discovery and serendipity at scale, benefitting guests and hotel partners.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Market Manager, your role will entail ensuring the health and expansion of our supply in Phoenix, Arizona. This will involve managing Hotels, optimizing their set-up via discounts, availability and other levers. Your focus will be to enhance Airbnb's market presence in your designated region through collaboration with other teams, leveraging your expertise on the local market. With a deep understanding of Airbnb's mission and values, you will oversee all aspects of the hotel’s  success on HotelTonight and Airbnb. This includes developing tiering and account management strategies, converting Hotel leads, and managing relationships with strategic partners, as well as internal stakeholders. You will also be tasked with developing and refining scalable, localized supply management strategies for both established, competitive markets and emerging, untapped markets, aiming to secure our long-term success in these regions.

A Typical Day: 

  • Build, manage and expand partner relationships within your territory, aiming to surpass quarterly sales targets with Hotels.
  • Conduct regular optimization calls and business reviews with partners to develop strong, enduring partnerships providing exceptional, timely service to hosts, including in-person support as needed.
  • Implement strategies to effectively manage and optimize the long tail of thousands of Hotels in your region.
  • Educate clients on all significant product updates and cascade feedback on product and public policy to the relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Leverage data to identify and pursue strategic growth opportunities, demonstrating an ability to navigate operational complexities and efficiently allocate resources.
  • Use an entrepreneurial approach to develop and implement unique engagement projects, fostering innovation within your territory.
  • Work cross-functionally with teams such as product, communications, public policy, legal, tax and customer support to ensure Airbnb's long-term market success.
  • Acquire comprehensive knowledge of local market trends to inform both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Understand the technical aspects of software partnerships to offer comprehensive support, ensuring a seamless experience for hosts and guests.
  • Represent Airbnb in external meetings with Hotels and at industry conferences in your market, solidifying the brand's presence and commitment.

Your Expertise:

  • 6+ years of experience in new sales, account management, and partner support, showcasing a deep understanding and capability in fostering business relationships.
  • 2+ years of tech/travel industry experience is a plus, highlighting the value of sector-specific knowledge.
  • Proven track record of being able to effectively work a book of business, demonstrating expertise in nurturing and converting potential opportunities.
  • Proficient quantitative skills and proven ability to interpret and apply data throughout your day-to-day work, emphasizing the importance of data-driven decision-making.
  • The ability to work at both strategic and tactical levels, with a proven track record to execute in ambiguous environments, highlighting adaptability and strategic foresight.
  • Proven experience working cross-functionally, ensuring the ability to collaborate effectively with various teams to drive collective success.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to communicate effectively with clients via phone, email, and in-person, underscoring the importance of strong interpersonal skills.
  • Charismatic self-starter who is resourceful and self-sufficient, paired with strong time management and prioritization skills, showcasing the initiative and organizational capabilities required for the role.
  • Highly proficient in using CRM software, specifically in working with leads, opportunities, and other core objects - Salesforce experience is a plus, indicating the technical tools proficiency needed for effective relationship management.
  • Based in Phoenix, Arizona and must be willing to regularly travel to your assigned territory. Typical expectation would be once every 4 to 6 weeks.
  • Passion for Airbnb, travel, and the sharing economy - being an Airbnb host is a plus, culminating the profile with a personal alignment and enthusiasm for the company's mission and sector.

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in Phoenix, Arizona to be able to conduct their work. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

The Community You Will Join:

You'll join the Payments Platform Engineering team, which owns everything involved in settling money in Airbnb's global marketplace, from collecting guest payments to paying out hosts. The team builds the platform behind all of Airbnb's lines of business, across infrastructure, core payment services, and user-facing payment experiences. You'll work closely with product managers, data scientists, designers, and operations, as well as engineering teams across Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

You'll design and build the next generation of Airbnb's Payments Platform: scalable, highly available systems that process massive daily transaction volume. Success means shipping reliable, well-instrumented services and product features end-to-end, with strong code quality and observability, while making Airbnb the safest and easiest-to-use payments platform.

A Typical Day: 

  • Design and build service-oriented, modular, observable backend systems with well-defined APIs.
  • Partner with product managers, data scientists, and operations to turn evolving business needs into product features.
  • Take features from ideation through planning, scoping, implementation, and experimental A/B testing.
  • Set up and tune monitoring and alerting to raise the quality and reliability of our systems.
  • Write high-quality, well-tested code and review others' code to uphold engineering best practices.
  • Work with other engineering teams across Airbnb to improve our engineering process and technical foundation.


Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, ideally in Payments or Fintech.
  • Proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin, and comfort working within a microservices environment (RPC frameworks, service IDLs, dependency injection), plus familiarity with React or a similar JavaScript framework.
  • Experience with architectural patterns of large, high-scale web applications, such as well-designed APIs, high-volume data pipelines, and efficient algorithms.
  • Experience delivering products end-to-end, including A/B testing.
  • Commitment to code quality, automated testing, and engineering best practices.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail, with experience collaborating in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to make data-driven decisions and clearly articulate technical tradeoffs.
  • Bachelor's and/or Master's degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience.

A genuine and demonstrated interest in Airbnb and a commitment to ethics, integrity and fostering a workplace that emphasizes diversity and belonging is a must.

Airbnb’s Legal Department embodies the company’s innovative, forward-thinking spirit. At the frontier of the sharing economy, Airbnb is breaking new ground in matters of policy, law and government relations. Where some see obstacles, we see the opportunity to find creative, practical solutions, right at the cutting edge. Our adventurous, fast-moving legal team is committed to building a team of talented, collaborative and self-motivated legal professionals across the globe who believe in Airbnb’s mission and leading as a 21st century company.

Reporting to Airbnb’s Lead Counsel, Corporate, you will partner closely with Airbnb’s Corporate Development team and other legal and cross-functional teams on M&A as well as other corporate and investment transactions. From time to time, you may also provide legal support for other teams (e.g., Sustainability, Treasury) as part of the Corporate Legal team’s general practice.

title: Principal, Strategic Finance & Analytics, Technology
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Technology Finance partners across Infrastructure, Engineering, and Product teams to plan, forecast, and manage the cost of running Airbnb's cloud and AI platforms. The team sits at the intersection of finance and technical infrastructure, translating usage trends — cloud compute, storage, and AI spend — into forecasts and cost narratives that inform company-wide investment decisions. Key cross-functional partners include Engineering, Procurement, and FP&A, among others.

The Difference You Will Make:

This role owns the understanding, forecasting, and influencing of Airbnb's total cloud and AI spend, spanning traditional AWS infrastructure and AI. Success looks like a cost narrative leadership can act on, and identified efficiency opportunities that measurably bend the cost curve without degrading product or employee experience. This includes leading planning cycles (FY26 close-out, FY27 guidance) and driving month-over-month rigor in cost variance analysis.

A Typical Day: 

  • Build and maintain the monthly/weekly cloud and AI cost forecast, reconciling actuals against plan and explaining variance drivers to leadership.
  • Track AI spend by category and by model/provider mix, flagging shifts in usage or pricing that affect the forecast.
  • Partner with Infrastructure and AI Platform engineering teams to size, validate, and prioritize efficiency initiatives (model routing, token optimization, provider migration).
  • Own migration-tracking reporting (e.g., provider mix shifts, cost impact of model changes) and ensure the underlying data is traceable back to source systems.
  • Prepare and present cost updates to a broad, senior audience, translating technical usage data into clear financial narratives.
  • Identify and quantify new cost efficiency opportunities in partnership with technical stakeholders, and track them through to landed savings.
  • Run monthly and ad hoc reviews with Finance and Tech leadership

Your Expertise:

  • 10 years of finance, FP&A, or cost management experience, ideally including direct exposure to cloud infrastructure costs 
  • Prior experience with AI/ML infrastructure costs strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain complex financial models and forecasts in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
  • Strong track record partnering with engineering/technical teams to translate usage data

title: Senior Manager, Safety
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

No global movement springs from individuals. It takes an entire team united behind something big. On the Delivery team at Airbnb, we're proud to be at the forefront of the sharing economy. We recognize that we are the leaders of a new, worldwide phenomenon, and that's why we're working so hard to build the world's most loyal travel community.

Together, our team provides support to more than 100 million lifetime guests and 3 million listings in over 191 countries. Our India Global operations hub delivers several of Community Support's most sensitive and complex specialty services, working as one team with our global process leads. We are looking for an agile, operationally strong leader who knows how to motivate and inspire teams in a cutting-edge and fast-paced environment.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Manager, Safety you will own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of Global Operation's most sensitive and highest-severity specialty services, spanning close to 200 team members across Specialists, Team Specialists, Supervisors and Managers. You will be accountable for KPIs, people and the overall health of the business, with direct exposure to user-safety, regulatory and financial-loss risk and the authority to make final calls on complex, irreversible decisions. 

You will act as senior delivery partner to the global process leads for your services — translating global agendas into on-the-ground execution and giving those leads a single accountable counterpart at site. You will be expected to build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders while constantly looking for opportunities to streamline and optimize our operations. As our portfolio evolves, you should expect the mix of services in scope to change, and be comfortable picking up new skills and queues as the business requires.

A Typical Day:

Drive delivery performance across the portfolio:

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of the services in scope, driving the highest level of performance from the teams and establishing the right performance management and coaching structure and cadence in collaboration with Delivery leaders and Quality teams
  • Define, monitor, report and improve efficiency and quality metrics for each service based on its performance scorecard, keeping Global operations in India aligned to global standards while accounting for local nuance
  • Adapt and pre-empt adaptations of the performance management structure based on shifting business priorities, volume patterns and peak planning
  • Bring a data-driven lens to occupancy, SLA, capacity and workforce decisions, and make timely calls when the numbers move

Lead and grow a multi-layered leadership team:

  • Lead a mixed layer of leadership — a Manager alongside Supervisors reporting in directly — which means being comfortable leading junior leadership hands-on rather than only through a manager layer
  • Coach Supervisors on daily performance management as readily as you set quarterly direction, and stay close enough to the floor to spot execution gaps early
  • Support Managers and Supervisors to ensure high employee engagement and delivery of a world class experience for both our community and our internal stakeholders
  • Oversee team structure, recruitment, onboarding, training and upskilling plans, and build a credible succession and cross-skilling pipeline across the portfolio
  • Be a focused, visible leader who creates supportive connections across the whole team through open communication, and who carries teams through change and periods of instability

Partner with global process leads and eliminate functional silos:

  • Stay ahead of global Ops priorities and make sure ACC delivery is set up to execute them — owning the on-the-ground landing of global programmes to timeline and quality
  • Surface operational pain points early enough to influence global design rather than after the fact, and carry ACC best practice back into the global forums
  • Work across services and with Quality, Training, Business Process Improvement, Analytics and WFM to eliminate functional and working silos, so process changes land consistently rather than function by function
  • Feed insights into process, policy and tooling improvements, and drive relationships and coordinate requests with shared services teams
  • Support the global consolidation agenda where ACC is scaling towards becoming the primary or sole servicing site for a skill, ensuring transitions land without disruption to the community

Manage senior and executive stakeholders:

  • Be responsible and accountable for executive and senior leadership stakeholder management, adapting your communication to the audience and remaining flexible and available to our leaders
  • Have a deep understanding and expertise of our operations, workflows, policies and systems, so you can assess cases yourself and make the right call on what needs to be done to solve our users' issues
  • Represent ACC credibly in global forums, holding policy, quality and risk conversations independently

Work with the long term in mind to reduce the volume and severity of complex cases:

  • Track and understand the common themes behind complex cases and escalations, close the loop, and set up the right forums to solve root causes with cross-functional teams across Global Ops
  • Partner with cross-functional Airbnb teams to champion improvements to our process, policies and product that improve the customer experience and reduce community escalations

Your Expertise:

  • Strong end-to-end frontline operations management experience in a customer-facing environment, with a track record of owning KPIs, people and business health for a large team; overall experience of minimum 13 years.
  • Highly agile — able to pick up new skills, services and queues quickly, and to re-prioritize as the portfolio and global agenda shift
  • Advanced people leadership, performance management, coaching and mentoring experience, including leading through both a manager layer and direct supervisor relationships
  • Comfortable operating hands-on with junior leadership: coaching Supervisors on daily execution while holding a longer-term agenda
  • Ability to work in a high-pressure environment with visibility to sensitive, confidential and potentially traumatic content, and to support a team working with the same
  • Experience in complex case management with VP-level stakeholders and above preferred; crisis management or Trust & Safety experience in a marketplace business is an advantage
  • Strong influencing, presentation, interpersonal and teamwork skills — able to work collaboratively and consultatively across expansive business partner organizations, including global process leads and shared services
  • Ability to handle multiple complex, fast-moving situations at once and make sound decisions with incomplete information
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills, able to switch between very tactical, urgent work and long-term planning or programme management
  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to operations
  • High energy, strong attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to take a team through significant change
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent required; MBA or other Master's degree preferred
  • Ability to flex working hours to respond to global business demand; a high level of reactivity is expected
  • Comfortable to work in 24*7 rotational shifts with your team, and work from office in Gurugram.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Please note this is a hybrid 12 month fixed-term contract position from our Paris office. Please submit your CV in English.

The Community You Will Join

The Global Markets Strategic Finance & Analytics team provides budget oversight, reporting, strategic planning and analytical decision making support to the Global Markets team and in-region business teams across EMEA. In addition this team supports identifying and pursuing opportunities to drive growth and business impact for our international business.


The Difference You Will Make

  • While your formal reporting structure is into the Director, Strategic Finance & Analytics, EMEA, on a day-to-day basis you will work closely with the cross-functional team that is based in-region. 
  • You will directly support Country Managers (and their teams) based around EMEA to drive clear reporting, produce actionable insight, track core KPIs, evaluate investment decisions and work cross-functionally to develop strategies to solve problems.
  • The individual is expected to be a strong cross-functional business partner who has a combination of hands-on analytical skills, financial modelling expertise, commercial acumen, and the ability to package their insights into strong narratives appropriate for senior executive consumption. They will be comfortable working in cross functional teams based in EMEA and around the world including Finance & Accounting, Business Operations, Data Science, Marketing, Product and Supply.
  • The ideal candidate relishes the opportunity to roll up their sleeves to drive meaningful impact, possess strong stakeholder management skills, and is a self-starter that is comfortable with ambiguity in a fast paced global work environment.
  • This person will have a high degree of visibility with senior management within the organization, including Country Managers, Regional and Finance Leaders. 


A Typical Day

  • Partner with a Country Manager in driving performance management, including development and ongoing analysis of KPIs, creating goals/OKRs and measuring performance.
  • Develop a deep understanding of what levers drive growth and efficiency for our business and translating that into investment cases and initiatives to drive business impact.
  • Partnering with the business on annual planning and budgeting, laying out risks and opportunities and debating strategies and capital allocation to maximise growth.
  • Stepping in to lead EMEA’s monthly business review and speaking to key drivers of variance to goal and potential actions to improve performance.
  • Modelling and summarising the implications of a regulatory action and potential mitigating actions we could take to minimize business impact.
  • Joining a call with the Regional Marketing team to discuss changes to channel or country spend and helping bridge local and regional considerations.
  • Digging into the regional impact of a global product feature and identifying relevant regional insights that could point to local optimization opportunities.
  • Analytical deep dives: Conduct deep dives into business trends across EMEA and different segments of the business. Independently lead data extraction, analysis, visualization, and presentation. 
  • Build ad hoc reporting and analysis to help business operations and other cross functional partners understand the drivers of performance for key performance indicators.


Your Expertise

  • 3+ years of relevant experience. Ideally, you have demonstrated relevant experience in an analytical role such as Strategic Finance, Financial Planning and Analytics (FP&A), Strategy/Management Consulting, Investment Banking or Business Operations. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, accounting, engineering, statistics or other relevant field that demonstrates quantitative orientation; MBA or advanced degree a plus.
  • Superb financial modeling and quantitative analysis skills, SQL experience highly preferred.
  • Strong analytical abilities and able to synthesize complex information. You enjoy absorbing large amounts of data and qualitative insights and can quickly develop a strong narrative that leads to recommendations and builds our understanding of the business.
  • Stakeholder Management: The ability to work and influence cross-functionally in a matrixed business environment is a must. You are proactive, great at communicating with different audiences and can bring stakeholders on-board. You seek out and have a track record for driving change and impact in a fluid, unstructured working environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to put together clear, polished, insightful recommendations for peers, managers and senior management.
  • You’re very comfortable with financial modeling in Excel, and are willing to gather internal and external data points to help build a comprehensive business case.
  • You’re someone who possesses grit and finds creative ways to get the job done. You bring high energy and the ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast paced environment while balancing multiple projects.
  • Relevant Sector Experience: Experience in B2C technology businesses is preferred, particularly Marketplace/Classifieds/E-Commerce businesses; broader experience in B2B technology, including Fintech and B2B Software will also be considered.
  • Fluent in English and French.
  • Experience in travel and hospitality is a plus.

title: Senior Operations Manager, Luxe
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Airbnb’s mission of providing inspiring travel experiences for our hosts and guests is heavily reliant on our Supply teams’ success in ensuring high quality supply in the market. 

The Homes Enterprise team sits at the heart of this mission. title: Lead Business Process Improvement
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

The Business Process Improvement team focuses on improving processes across all Community Support. Our team is a global team of process improvement professionals, who help bring cross functional partners from across CS and Airbnb together to operationalize new processes, analyze current process for improvement opportunities, and scale solutions across a global network. We follow general business process engineering principles and practices, as well as leveraging Lean Six Sigma methodologies in our improvement projects.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Business Process Improvement (BPI) Lead you are responsible for driving large-scale, cross-functional improvement projects that help to improve customer support for our community.  

You will deliver new process designs and process improvements for key priority Community Support (CS) Roadmap programs, where you will take on responsibilities for process analysis, process design, pilot design and execution, and control plan development to improve the user experience.

You will work cross-functionally with other Shared Services functions, Policy, and Product  teams to lead the process impact assessment and subsequent process design for high priority changes. You will drive continuous improvement with these cross functional partners to increase overall operational efficiency, customer experience, and process quality.

You will use and improve AI tools in order to design and implement process measurement systems, analyze process data and utilize this information to drive decision making, successful improvement projects to completion, and propose Continuous Improvement projects. You will create queries and utilize data analytics tools to support process improvement efforts. You will validate analytics with your data partners.

You will be responsible for the delivery of successful improvement projects with measurable positive impact and also transition these solutions to operations for sustained results including feature launches throughout the year.

A Typical Day: 

  • Leads large cross-functional process engineering initiatives from problem definition through measurable outcomes, applying the full suite of Lean Six Sigma tools and a structured process engineering framework across four disciplines: understanding the problem and its system context, designing reliable and measurable solutions, grounding those solutions in operational reality, and evolving them as conditions change.
  • Apply systems thinking: mapping full upstream and downstream context before prescribing solutions, identifying where the real problem lives rather than where it surfaces.
  • Design processes for AI-readiness and automation, including designing around three standards: reduce agent and customer burden, measurable from day one, and ability to be automated or self-correcting over time.
  • Build some AI prototypes to communicate and validate process designs, using AI tools, workflow automation platforms, and lightweight modeling approaches to test the viability of new process architectures before committing to full implementation.
  • Use some basic process simulation to model how a designed process will behave under real-world conditions, stress-testing assumptions about volume, variation, and failure modes before a design is deployed.
  • Continuously improve process designs of Community Support experiences that document the full interaction across the customer journey, agent processes, product features, and policies, informing multi-year roadmap planning.
  • Implement process measurement systems from the start of every design: establish KPIs, deploy statistical process control methods, and track outcomes post-launch to confirm improvements hold.
  • Lead change management for process transitions, ensuring new designs are adopted effectively by agents, teams, and partners and that improvements are sustained over time.
  • Partner with Product and Technology teams to translate process requirements into tooling specifications, ensuring AI and other product capabilities are engineered around how agents and customers actually work.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Analytics, and Operations to align priorities and drive trade-off decisions grounded in data.
  • Communicate progress and findings to leadership, distilling complex analysis into clear narratives with a line of sight to measurable outcomes
  • Organizes their work, keeps project stakeholders updated, and is able to work autonomously to drive progress across stakeholders.

Your Expertise:

  • Preferred Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of post-graduate experience in operations (industrial engineering or similar preferred experience)
  • Advanced knowledge of customer service and contact center operations
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certified or equivalent process engineering expertise. Additional consideration given to Agile, service design, and Industrial and Systems Engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve quality and efficiency within internal workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to design processes for AI-readiness and automation.
  • Proven experience applying systems thinking to process design, identifying root causes upstream and tracing impacts downstream before prescribing solutions.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity with creative problem-solving, strong analytical skills, and a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with minimal direction.
  • Strong statistical and data-driven analytical skills, including statistical process control methods, regression analysis, and measurement system analysis.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of time

descriptionHtml:

The Community You Will Join

Organic search is one of Airbnb's largest and most efficient acquisition channels, and the rise of AI answer engines is reshaping how travelers discover places to stay, things to do, and trusted Hosts. This role sits at the intersection of growth marketing, content strategy, and emerging AI search behavior, partnering closely with product, engineering, content, and data science teams to make Airbnb the trusted source that search engines and AI models cite.

The Difference You Will Make

As Senior Growth Marketing Lead, SEO, AEO, GEO, you will own the strategy and day-to-day execution for how Airbnb shows up in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and the assistants that come next. You are an execution-focused operator with a career built in SEO — you write your own SQL, size opportunities from raw data, and ship. Success in this role means measurable gains in organic visibility, rankings, AI citations, traffic, bookings, and downstream conversion, along with a measurement framework that proves the business value of organic channels. This is a chance to define what AEO and GEO mean for Airbnb and build the playbook others follow.

A Typical Day

  • Own the organic growth strategy and content roadmap across SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — covering technical SEO, content, on-site experience, and visibility in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.
  • Manage internal content strategy for these acquisition channels: set priorities, briefs, templates, and quality standards for content and landing pages that drive organic and AI-referred traffic.
  • Run the channel hands-on — pull and analyze your own data in SQL, size opportunities, prioritize by impact, and drive launches and experiments from backlog to measured result.
  • Lead cross-functional relationships with product and engineering teams, embedding SEO and AEO best practices into web properties, app surfaces, and structured data.
  • Improve how well AI models understand Airbnb's listings, product, and policies so they represent Airbnb accurately and cite it as a source.
  • Build and evolve the measurement framework for SEO, AEO, and GEO — attribution models, leading and lagging indicators, dashboards, and revenue impact — including the ability to demonstrate the value of work that's difficult to attribute, such as preventive technical work or emerging AI channels.
  • Establish Airbnb's point of view on how AI-generated answers are reshaping travel discovery, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business narratives for senior leaders.

Your Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in SEO, including 2+ years in a senior/leadership capacity engaging with executives.
  • Strong SQL skills, writing your own queries to analyze crawl, log, search console, and conversion data without relying on analysts for core questions.
  • Proven track record of shipping SEO programs at scale and driving significant organic growth, from prioritization through launch and measurement.
  • Expertise in both technical SEO and content strategy, including site architecture, structured data, indexation, and content quality.
  • Working knowledge of how AI-powered search and answer engines operate (LLM-based retrieval, citation behavior, entity recognition), with a clear point of view on how to optimize for them.
  • Strong analytical foundation, comfortable with attribution challenges and building measurement frameworks that quantify the business impact of organic channels.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, content, and data science teams to implement SEO and AEO improvements at scale, and a track record of developing and retaining high-performing teams.
  • Preferred: experience in a two-sided marketplace or travel business where listing, location, and user-generated content pages are major organic surfaces; background in international SEO across multiple markets and languages; experience building programmatic or product-led SEO at scale; early-mover experience in AEO/GEO visibility monitoring and optimization; hands-on skill with Python, BigQuery, or similar tools and log/crawl analysis at scale.
