title: Product Manager, Social Features
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Our Product Marketing Managers start with the guest and work backwards, turning product thinking, data, and research into strategy. They own outcomes end to end, lead cross-functional teams across engineering, design, data science, and program management, and stay close enough to the details to know when something is off.

The Social team is making Airbnb a place where you travel with, and because of, the people you know. Our strategy has three parts: scaling the social graph, building social features that make Airbnb fun and useful for you and your friends, and creating social experiences that help people form new relationships and strengthen existing ones in real life. Each part has its own dedicated pod of engineers, designers, and program partners.

The Difference You Will Make

As Product Marketing Manager for Social Features, you'll lead a new pod that turns guests' connections into reasons to come back to Airbnb. You'll own the features people use with their friends: the travel map and sharing it, group travel tools, recommendations from people you know, and how connections are woven across Airbnb to make the whole travel experience better. You'll own the outcome, not just the roadmap: you'll make the calls on scope and priority with a dedicated engineering lead, engineers, and design partner, and be accountable for the results. You'll take features from brief to launch, use experiment results to decide what to build next, and grow how often guests plan, book, and share trips with the people they know. You'll also write the product narrative that explains each release to leadership and to guests.

A Typical Day

  • Work backwards from the guest: write crisp briefs and requirements for new features, each grounded in a real guest need and a clear definition of success
  • Prototype with AI first: build working prototypes yourself to explore ideas, test them with guests, and align the team in days rather than weeks
  • Drive execution with engineering, design, data science, and program management, from concept through launch and iteration, often with several features in flight at once
  • Go deep with the team on the details: review builds, test flows yourself, and chase down the edge cases that decide whether a feature delivers for guests
  • Shape how connections are integrated across the guest journey, from search and booking to Trips, so planning and traveling with people you know feels natural
  • Build shareable, delightful moments like the travel map that bring new people to Airbnb and grow the social graph
  • Partner with the social graph and social experiences pods, and with Trips, Search, Checkout, and other partner teams, to ship work that spans surfaces
  • Design for trust and privacy from the start, with clear controls over what people share and with whom
  • Put mechanisms in place, like goals and a weekly metrics review, so the team knows where it stands and acts on it
  • Partner with data scientists on experiments, dive deep into the results, and make clear calls on what to scale, iterate on, or stop
  • Present strategy and results in leadership reviews, turning complex tradeoffs into clear decisions and concise narratives

Your Expertise

  • 8+ years in product marketing or product management, with a track record of moving a core consumer metric (engagement, retention, sharing, or conversion) through features you led to launch
  • Experience building social or network-driven products: sharing, invites, feeds, profiles, group features, or connection-based recommendations
  • Deeply AI-native in how you work: you use AI tools every day for prototyping, research, specs, and analysis, and you've changed how your team builds because of it
  • Obsessed with the details: you go as deep as it takes with engineering and design, from data to edge cases, to make sure what ships drives great outcomes for guests
  • Strong execution and a bias for action: you've led cross-functional teams through complex launches on time and at a high quality bar, and you move fast on decisions that are easy to reverse
  • Fluent in experiment results: you can define what a test needs to learn, read growth metrics alongside guardrails like trust, privacy, and satisfaction, and turn them into product decisions
  • Strong judgment of consumer product quality, a high bar for craft, and a clear sense of what makes an experience fun, useful, and worth sharing
  • Comfort working in a new, fast-moving area where you set the roadmap and build the team's operating rhythm
  • Ability to earn the trust of engineering, design, and data science partners and lead without formal authority
  • Clear, structured writer and communicator who can distill complex tradeoffs for executives and translate strategy into actionable guidance for teams
  • Experience at a consumer marketplace or travel company, or launching a new social product at scale (preferred)

descriptionHtml:

On the Hotels CX team at Airbnb, we support the guests who book with HotelTonight and the hotels who host them on HotelTonight and Airbnb. Hotels are a growing part of what Airbnb offers travelers, and it's an area the company is investing in heavily right now, which means this team's work sits at the center of how that experience takes hold. Every guest we take care of and every hotel partner we support well shapes how hotels grow on Airbnb.

As a Hotels CX Supervisor, you'll coach, motivate, and manage a team of Hotel Specialists and Team Specialists, making sure they have what they need to serve our guests and our hotel partners exceptionally. You'll work closely with Hotels CX leadership to evaluate and manage team performance and quality, and to execute the processes and policies that deliver a seamless experience.

A Typical Day: 

Builds and Nurtures Team Engagement and Well Being

  • Own and manage end to end people strategy and operations within your team, including onboarding, talent development, and engagement.
  • Hold regular one on ones, used for coaching and development rather than status updates.
  • Ensure engagement by building strong connections and translating Airbnb's mission into meaningful, clear goals for your team.
  • Lead with empathy to establish approachability, and to support and challenge the team to meet and exceed expectations.
  • Enable professional and personal growth through feedback, opportunity creation, and expectation setting.
  • Handle day to day management duties: scheduling, time off approvals, team meetings, and basic HR related matters.
  • Build morale by sharing wins, fostering open dialogue, and creating a sense of belonging.

Performance Accountability

  • Manage individual performance to ensure policy compliance and delivery against quality, efficiency, and other performance targets.
  • Hold team members accountable fairly and equitably by setting clear expectations, following up individually, and coaching in a way tailored to each person.
  • Deliver difficult feedback directly and early rather than letting issues accumulate.

title: Staff Data Engineer, Tech Foundations
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Staff Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations

The Community You Will Join:

At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.

You will lead complex initiatives from problem definition and architectural design through implementation, validation, and production operations. You will build extensible data foundations that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while maintaining clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data.

Operating in an ecosystem that includes petabyte-scale datasets, you will improve correctness, freshness, performance, and cost efficiency. You will develop reusable frameworks that simplify source onboarding, reduce duplicated logic, and make critical data easier to discover and use. Through mentorship and contributions to Airbnb’s shared data engineering tools and standards, your impact will extend across the data community.

A Typical Day:

  • Lead the architecture, implementation, and operation of high-impact data pipelines across AI usage and cost, Unit Economics, enterprise applications, and critical Financial metrics.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define how AI adoption, consumption, and spending are measured across the organization, and build consistent data models that support those definitions.
  • Evolve Unit Economics datasets to connect revenue and diverse cost drivers, enabling teams to understand product profitability and resource efficiency.
  • Build reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines for non-platform systems such as Jira and other BizTech enterprise applications.
  • Translate ambiguous requirements into clear source contracts, reusable fact and dimension models, and technical designs.
  • Develop configurable pipelines and shared components that simplify onboarding new data sources, products, and business requirements.
  • Establish automated testing, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring to protect data accuracy, completeness, and availability.
  • Lead safe migrations and historical backfills through dependency analysis, validation, controlled cutovers, and recovery planning.
  • Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance to improve freshness and reduce compute costs.
  • Own production reliability through on-call participation, incident response, and lasting improvements to systems and runbooks.
  • Shape the technical roadmap, lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and contribute improvements to Airbnb’s Data Engineering Paved Path.

Your Expertise:

  • 9+ years of relevant industry experience with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; or 6+ years of relevant experience with a PhD.
  • A track record of leading complex data engineering initiatives from ambiguous requirements through architecture, delivery, and sustained production ownership.
  • Deep expertise in SQL and strong programming skills in Python or Scala, with experience building maintainable, well-tested data systems.
  • Extensive experience with distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark and large-scale analytical storage systems.
  • Strong data modeling skills, including fact and dimension design, slowly changing dimensions, incremental processing, and historical data management.
  • Experience integrating heterogeneous sources, including APIs, enterprise applications, event data, and transactional systems, while managing schema changes and source reliability.
  • Proven ability to build reliable pipelines and execute migrations and backfills while preserving correctness and downstream compatibility.
  • Experience establishing data quality controls, observability, lineage, governance, and effective incident recovery practices.
  • Strong performance engineering skills, including diagnosing bottlenecks and optimizing distributed computation, storage, and query execution.
  • The ability to align stakeholders across engineering and business functions, communicate architectural tradeoffs, and drive decisions across team boundaries.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through mentorship, architectural guidance, and improvements to shared engineering practices.
  • Curiosity and sound judgment when learning new domains and balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.

Experience with AI usage or cost measurement, cloud cost attribution, Unit Economics, enterprise application data, or financial and payments datasets is a plus. Familiarity with workflow orchestration, SQL transformation frameworks, and modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg is also valuable.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb's mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. We are seeking a technical, hands-on, mission-driven Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead Infrastructure Security initiatives, working with security and infrastructure engineers to keep the Airbnb platform secure, resilient, and transparent. You will partner closely with senior ICs and senior leaders across Airbnb on processes, strategy and execution.

Airbnb is built on trust. Information Security is a horizontal function that spans the company to protect the platform millions of people use to explore the world and belong anywhere, including the cloud and data infrastructure everything else runs on.

We are looking for someone who pairs program leadership with hands-on technical depth in security and infrastructure, understands the problem space, drives requirements, and tackles strategic challenges that align with Airbnb's larger goals.

The Difference You Will Make

You will play a crucial role in tackling projects that protect the cloud or data infrastructure behind the entire Airbnb platform, directly supporting the trust that guests and hosts place in us. Success in this role requires a strong sense of ownership, coupled with the ability to think critically and strategically while managing relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.

A Typical Day

  • Shape and influence the technical direction of infrastructure security projects, ensuring we meet stakeholder needs while maintaining high-quality standards. Rapidly prototype and validate project ideas through iterative development cycles, adapting as necessary based on insights and data.
  • Balance broad, outcome-driven thinking with attention to critical details, exercising sound judgment to prioritize where deep focus is necessary to ensure successful execution.
  • Define and secure stakeholder alignment on clear, measurable success criteria for security initiatives. Regularly assess risks and opportunities, and devise proactive mitigation strategies to maintain momentum and project success.
  • Maintain transparent and effective communication channels to keep stakeholders informed of progress, developments, and challenges.
  • Expertly present outcomes and updates to senior leadership, clearly and comprehensively articulating trade-offs, risks, and emerging opportunities.

Your Expertise

  • 10+ years of work experience, with at least 8 years as a TPM or relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to work through ambiguity to detailed solutions. You can take a vague problem, crisply frame the challenge, identify a path forward, and drive an initiative over the finish line.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and proven ability to adapt well and work with teams having different operating cadences.
  • Sound business judgment, a proven ability to influence others, strong analytical skills, and a track record of taking ownership, leading data-driven analyses, and influencing results.
  • Hands-on technical experience with infrastructure security, such as identity and access management, network security, encryption and key management, secure configuration, container and Kubernetes security, and data protection in cloud environments or data platforms.

locations: California, United States, Oregon, United States, Washington, United States
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. It takes a unified team committed to our core values to achieve this goal. Airbnb’s various functions embody the company’s innovative spirit, and our fast-moving team is committed to leading as a 21st century company.

The Content & Knowledge Management (CKM) team that you would join makes accurate and authoritative information available at scale by creating, editing, and managing metadata and support content—including the public Help Center and internal knowledge bases—used by customers, CS agents, and consuming applications, including AI chatbots. 

The Difference You Will Make:

The Senior Manager, Content & Knowledge Architecture will help establish and evolve the emerging discipline of content engineering—designing, structuring, delivering, and managing content so it’s strategic, scalable, consumable across surfaces, and efficiently adjusted, rather than a collection of one-off articles or chunks—within our organization. 

In this leadership role, you'll own CKM inputs and influence infrastructure that construct and ingest an information layer, which serves various audiences and product surfaces. You will own decisions that determine how knowledge is created, updated, architected, organized, stored, retrieved, and surfaced. You'll also steer the cross-functional coordination that keeps CKM content aligned with product launches and other business developments or needs.

You’ll lead the teams who run taxonomy and ontology, content tooling and AI-focused optimization, as well as content operations planning. You’ll be accountable for how well they perform together: setting direction, clarifying who owns what, and developing the leaders and teams who make it work.

We seek someone who sees how systems underneath our content — taxonomy, tooling, authoring processes, information architecture, and operational planning — increasingly determine whether that content reaches the people and machines that need it. You should understand how user-facing content, metadata, measurement and authoring systems, and consuming applications all depend on each other, and you can spot where inconsistency in one area will eventually break something in another. Most importantly, you should view these as a cohesive unit, not several separate functions that happen to share a roof.

A Typical Day: 

  • Define and champion the evolving discipline of content engineering within CKM, establishing standards for how knowledge is structured, stored, and delivered across surfaces and applications.
  • Own the roadmap for metadata, taxonomy, and information architecture that determines how content is organized, discovered, and reused.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define and prioritize tooling investment that improves content quality, efficiency, and innovation.
  • Establish governance frameworks that embed standards and quality checks directly into content creation, review, and publishing workflows.
  • Define the metrics and reporting that give leadership visibility into content health, coverage, and performance, as well as authoring efficiency.
  • Steer cross-functional coordination that keeps CKM content aligned with product launches and other business needs.
  • Lead and develop the managers and senior team members in your group: set clear goals, give candid feedback, and hold each accountable for results.
  • Own talent decisions for the group, including hiring, calibration, promotion, and succession planning, applying clear leveling criteria so people are developed and recognized fairly.
  • Define roles and ownership across taxonomy and ontology, tooling and AI-focused optimization, and content operations planning, so everyone in the group knows what they own, what they influence, and where work hands off. 
  • Set priorities and allocate resources and capacity across the group’s programs and roadmap.
  • Coach managers on team design and career development for their own teams, and help senior team members grow toward their next role. Sponsor a diverse group of talent and model Airbnb’s belonging behaviors.
  • Build strategic relationships with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Design, among others, to ensure knowledge systems keep pace with company-wide priorities.
  • Champion a culture of technical and data fluency, editorial and operational excellence, and continuous improvement across a diverse team.

Your Expertise:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in content strategy, content operations, or knowledge management, including substantial experience with content systems, taxonomy, and/or information architecture at scale.
  • 5+ years of managing managers, with a track record of developing high-performing, distributed teams, and steering them toward a shared strategy and standard.
  • Hands-on experience owning talent decisions, including hiring, performance management, calibration, and succession planning.
  • Experience in customer support, contact center operations, or a similar global service organization is a plus.
  • Advanced degree in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Information Science, Technical Writing, or similar) — or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep expertise in content strategy, knowledge management, and information architecture, with a demonstrated understanding of AI/ML applications in content operations.
  • Expert knowledge of content management systems and authoring tooling; practical experience with AI-powered content optimization.
  • Comfortable partnering directly with engineers on system architecture, data structures, and retrieval mechanics — deep technical fluency is essential.
  • Collaborative, solution-oriented, and able to execute at scale across genuinely distinct disciplines.
  • Highly developed executive presence, with the ability to build and present business cases to VP/C-level stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to steer and shape the work of multiple related teams and their leaders, removing ambiguity for executing parties and raising the capability of an already-strong team.
  • A proven people leader who hires, develops, and retains senior talent, coaches leaders through growth and difficult conversations, and builds an inclusive team where people feel they belong.
  • Skilled at joining an established team and leading it through change: earns trust quickly, respects existing expertise, and aligns leaders around shared goals.

title: Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics & Research
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

People Analytics & Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on.

The Difference You Will Make:

The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action.

If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb’s community, we want to hear from you.

A Typical Day: 

  • Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze
  • Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others
  • Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business
  • Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders
  • Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards
  • Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting
  • Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb
  • Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver

Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field
  • Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis
  • Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access
  • Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit
  • Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact
  • Experience working with large practical datasets

descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence and guest-centred ethos that define Airbnb. Our mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotel partners easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You Will Make

Build a global team. Open doors no one at Airbnb has opened yet.

Airbnb Hotels is one of the most exciting growth stories in travel, and we’re only getting started. As Manager, Key Accounts, you will build and lead a brand new, globally distributed team of Enterprise Account Managers. Together you will win and onboard high-value, above-property hotel groups with hundreds of hotels across multiple continents.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • Proven leadership of a key, strategic or enterprise accounts team, ideally globally distributed
  • A network and reputation in travel and hospitality, ideally hotels
  • Real negotiation experience with high-value partners
  • A builder’s mindset, with a track record of creating teams, playbooks and processes where none existed
  • Strong cross-functional influence across a matrix organisation

What you’ll own:

  • End-to-end partner management at hotel headquarter and regional office level
  • Mutual account plans that drive supply and strategic relationship value
  • The global Key Accounts strategy, in line with the Enterprise Team playbook
  • A clear mandate to consistently exceed quarterly business KPIs
  • World-class account management practices, operational excellence and partner satisfaction
  • The voice of Key Accounts within Hotels leadership
  • A collaborative, growth-oriented team that you mentor and motivate

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence and guest-centred ethos that define Airbnb. Our mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotel partners easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You Will Make

Build a global team. Open doors no one at Airbnb has opened yet.

Airbnb Hotels is one of the most exciting growth stories in travel, and we’re only getting started. As Manager, Key Accounts, you will build and lead a brand new, globally distributed team of Enterprise Account Managers. Together you will win and onboard high-value, above-property hotel groups with hundreds of hotels across multiple continents. 

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • Proven leadership of a key, strategic or enterprise accounts team, ideally globally distributed
  • A network and reputation in travel and hospitality, ideally hotels
  • Real negotiation experience with high-value partners
  • A builder’s mindset, with a track record of creating teams, playbooks and processes where none existed
  • Strong cross-functional influence across a matrix organisation

What you’ll own:

  • End-to-end partner management at hotel headquarter and regional office level
  • Mutual account plans that drive supply and strategic relationship value
  • The global Key Accounts strategy, in line with the Enterprise Team playbook
  • A clear mandate to consistently exceed quarterly business KPIs
  • World-class account management practices, operational excellence and partner satisfaction
  • The voice of Key Accounts within Hotels leadership
  • A collaborative, growth-oriented team that you mentor and motivate

This position reports to the Global Head, Hotel Enterprise and Connectivity Partnerships, and offers a unique opportunity to shape Airbnb’s growth in the hotel market.

Why this role:

  • Lead a brand new team in a business that only launched this year
  • Shape the Key Accounts playbook from day one
  • Own the relationships, the targets and the strategy for a global segment
  • Work with a leadership team that is moving fast and backing this business

A Typical Day

  • Lead a distributed team of Enterprise Account Managers, supporting them on partner management and new business development for supply acquisition
  • Own the team’s quarterly revenue, supply acquisition and OKR targets, and ensure they are met and exceeded
  • Take partners from first conversation through negotiation, signed deal and onboarding
  • Develop and execute the Key Accounts playbook in line with global strategy, working closely with Hotel functional teams across regions
  • Manage and grow relationships with multi-national hotel groups, acting as an escalation option for your team where needed
  • Build the operational rhythm for the team: establish and track KPIs, analyse growth and key metrics to identify trends, surface new business opportunities, and resolve business challenges with urgency
  • Support the Hotels field team in achieving their goals through well-designed field-level action plans
  • Work closely with Product, Technical Support, Connectivity, RevOps and Hotels Cross-Functional Leadership to drive feature adoption and business performance
  • Represent Airbnb at industry and partner events, and organise internal partner events
  • Hold regular team meetings, 1:1s, and performance and development reviews
  • Organise team business gatherings, quarterly kick-offs and team-building events

Must-haves

  • 12+ years of professional experience and at least 8+ years in sales or account management roles in travel, hospitality or e-commerce
  • 6+ years of experience managing and leading high-performing teams, with a proven track record of meeting and exceeding goals
  • Experience leading a globally distributed team and driving solutions to improve supply acquisition and revenue goals, ideally across international markets
  • Established relationships with, or deep knowledge of, major hotel groups across the global hospitality landscape
  • Entrepreneurial mindset developed from experience having launched companies, teams or significant initiatives where resources, processes and capabilities had to be created, not handed to you or followed
  • Proven track record of preparing and executing complex negotiations with high-value partner organisations
  • Highly motivated team builder with the ability to coach and mentor account managers
  • Ability to develop a strategy, communicate it clearly, and secure buy-in and support to execute against quarterly goals
  • Strong analytical skills to identify opportunities, operationalise execution with regional teams, and drive business results
  • Ability to influence senior executives, both within regional Airbnb leadership and within partner leadership teams
  • Ability to work within a matrix, solve problems, and influence cross-functional and cross-regional teams, with strong stakeholder management across Marketing, Legal, FP&A, Payments, Product, regional field teams, and Enterprise and Connectivity teams
  • Fluency in English required
  • Willingness to travel globally up to 60% of the time as needed to meet team members and engage with partners and customers at industry events

  • Experience in the hospitality technology space, including familiarity with OTAs and hotel distribution (strongly preferred)
  • Experience developing and driving channel sales and marketing initiatives with global partners
  • Proficiency with tools such as CRM tools (Salesforce), project management tools (Asana, Airtable), and business intelligence tools (Tableau, Looker, Claude)
  • French or another major European language

title: Product Manager, LATAM  (Mexico City, Mexico)
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Our Product Marketing team imagines the ideal experience for our community and works backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a product strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research. They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented, hands on and excellent communicators, capable of crafting compelling stories for both internal and external audiences. 

The Difference You Will Make:

The International Product Marketing team is part of the Worldwide Product Marketing team. We are looking for entrepreneurial product experts who are ready to jump in, roll their sleeves up and integrate with local and regional teams, while maintaining close alignment with the worldwide teams. This role will help build out the new functional area outside of the US and will be instrumental in shaping the organization as it evolves. The cross functional model we use at Airbnb requires close partnerships  across multiple teams – this role requires a highly collaborative, flexible individual who can influence and collaborate with teams across the world.

As the Product Manager based in our LATAM region, you will report to the Product Marketing Director for International Markets. As the product marketing leader for the market(s) in LATAM, you will play a pivotal role in understanding the needs, pain points, and behavior of users and translate those insights into innovative product features, capabilities and marketing strategies. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the travel industry at a market and broader regional level, and have a proven track record of driving product innovation. You will collaborate with the global business and country teams to develop partnerships that accelerate existing and new businesses. You will drive features  in major releases and for test and learn pilots, after having successfully championed customization and features for your target country/region. You will also determine how they are communicated to the public and the media in your region in partnership with other communications and marketing teams. You are responsible for the success of Airbnb products throughout their life cycle — from concept to release. You will be the voice of our products for the market in your region and love the journey from taking a product from idea to reality.

A Typical Day: 

  • Build deep expertise on Airbnb in your market/region through user research, marketplace data, and an understanding of the competitive landscape and be capable of synthesizing in a cohort product story input from multiple stakeholders and sources.
  • Work with other functional leaders in your market/region to articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Airbnb products and new businesses.
  • Implement best-in-class product development and management practices, including relevant go-to-market kits and information packs for local teams, while working with central and local teams.
  • Maintain and articulate a product feature and roadmap prioritization plan in collaboration with local teams.
  • Advocate for and execute new products that deliver impact for our business and users.
  • Communicate concisely and influence outcomes across all levels of the company, including country and regional executive teams.
  • Drive alignment across product teams (Technology, Design) and key cross-functional partners (Business, Supply, FP&A, Marketing, Global Operations, Customer Support, Trust, etc.) to ensure initiatives are prioritized for wider roll-out or piloted to test and learn
  • Define goals and success with clearly measurable objectives and key results for your area.
  • Build and seamlessly integrate partnerships in your country/region that expand existing businesses and build new ones.
  • Navigate regulatory and government requirements in partnership with Policy/Comms and regions/markets.
  • Craft the product narrative and marketing strategies that communicate the benefits and features of our products both internally and externally in collaboration with comms and other cross functional partners.
  • Develop and deliver engaging product demos to press, showcasing key features and functionalities.

Your Expertise:

  • 10-15 years of product management experience.
  • Demonstrated track record of product leadership. 
  • Comfortable with doing individual contributor product management work.
  • Success in building and scaling global consumer products and ecosystems that people love.
  • Experience creating product messaging and delivering to customers and the media.
  • Entrepreneurial track record of taking an idea to reality – start up experience a plus while capable of operating in a larger organization.
  • Ability to effectively use data and perform business analysis to support product strategy/decisions.
  • Capable of driving execution across teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly collaborative and results oriented.
  • Strong AI fluency: hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day product work (research, analysis, prototyping, communications).
  • Ability to spot where AI can improve products and team workflows, and turn those opportunities into shipped outcomes.
  • Ability and willingness to travel around 30-35% of the time.
  • Fluency in English and at least one other local language (Spanish or Portuguese).

Your Location:

This position is based in Mexico City, Mexico - Hybrid. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager.

descriptionHtml:

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Please note this is a hybrid position from our Paris office. Please submit your CV in English.

The Community you will join:

Our Supply Team is growing, and we want you to be part of it! As a Market Associate, you will play a crucial role in the retention, growth, and optimization of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts in your assigned territory. These hosts are individuals who manage their own property or support owners by hosting on their behalf. You will focus on building strong relationships with these hosts, helping them optimize their listings, improve pricing strategies, and enhance their overall success on Airbnb. 

The difference you will make:

As a Market Associate, you will be responsible for the retention and growth of long-tail Hosts in an assigned territory. You will establish and nurture business relationships with emerging entrepreneurs by suggesting and supporting strategic initiatives that drive their success on Airbnb. These initiatives will include supply optimization, pricing optimization, host recruitment, and platform education. In addition, as these Hosts successfully grow on the platform, it will be essential that you support them in delivering authentic, high-quality hosting that creates memorable guest experiences. Beyond one-to-one account management responsibilities, you’ll also support Market Managers on your team to deliver one-to-many education programs, such as webinars and scaled e-mail communication. Ultimately, this team will be responsible for helping long-tail Hosts thrive on Airbnb.

A typical day: 

  • Manage a book of business consisting of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts, ensuring their retention, growth, and optimization on Airbnb.
  • Conduct one-on-one optimization and onboarding conversations, providing strategic recommendations on pricing, availability, and listing quality.
  • Secure availability over high compression dates, ensuring hosts maximize their revenue potential.
  • Educate hosts on product updates and policy changes, while channeling their feedback to internal teams.
  • Respond to host inquiries and provide timely, high-quality support to improve their experience on the platform.
  • Analyze performance data to identify trends and take action on opportunities that drive increased bookings and host success.
  • Develop long-lasting relationships with hosts, ensuring they receive ongoing support tailored to their needs.

Your expertise: 

  • 3+ years of experience in new sales, account management, or partner support.
  • 2+ years of hospitality/travel industry experience (nice to have).
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts effectively.
  • Proven experience working a book of business, driving engagement and growth through proactive account management.
  • Highly goal-driven, with a strong bias for action and persistence in the face of challenges.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively via phone, email, and in-person.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools, particularly working with leads and opportunities (Salesforce experience is a plus).
  • Fluency in French & English.

The AirCover team is charged with ideating, building, launching, and managing the AirCover business inside of Airbnb. We have a huge responsibility to our community of Hosts and Guests to be there when things don’t go exactly as planned with their reservations. We have a lot of work to do in the coming years and we are looking for someone who will help us manage all of the things that need to be done to deliver best-in-class services to our community.

The Claims Experience team is part of the Aircover team. Claims Experience is responsible for providing premium support  for our users by tailoring the experience and services we offer to their own specific needs so that everyone can host and travel with confidence. We develop a deep empathy and understanding of each of our customer’s desires, and go above and beyond to create personalized interactions that leave lasting impressions throughout the end-to-end claims process.

The team drives operational success across each of the Aircover products, delivering Seamless Execution through the quality and speed of our interactions, whilst focusing on customer retention and the continued growth of our Airbnb community.

The Difference You Will Make:

You will be responsible for understanding the unique needs of our customers and go above and beyond to create personalized interactions that leave a lasting impression throughout the end-to-end claims process. 

You will treat customers with consistency, fairness and empathy so that they feel heard and understood, and will tailor the support provided to their specific needs to resolve issues efficiently and to a high level of mutual satisfaction.

By enhancing the customer experience from end to end you will help drive retention rates and ensure that everyone can travel and host on Airbnb with confidence.

A Typical Day: 

  • Evaluate, investigate and resolve claims submitted across our Aircover products (including but not limited to Host Damage Protection claims) including claims of high value and complexity that require complex investigation and negotiations to reach satisfactory outcomes
  • Closely monitor for fraud detection and mitigate risks associated with bad actors to protect the Airbnb brand and community
  • Verify all relevant facts and evidence to determine case resolution outcomes whilst following internal policies and workflows
  • Go above and beyond to create personalized interactions and exceptional premium support throughout the end-to-end claims process, tailoring the experience offered whilst ensuring each user’s needs and preferences are met with the highest level of care and attention 
  • Provide continuous education and guidance for users about our Aircover products, terms and policies to enable the seamless resolution of their requests
  • Work closely with stakeholders and third party claims administrators to align on case strategies and ensure a timely resolution is reached for our users
  • Communicate regularly with Supervisors and Manager to provide feedback on the status of claims 
  • Maintain high levels of confidentiality whilst conducting investigations
  • Identify gaps in workflow, process or policy whilst striving to provide upward feedback as required to further improve the experience for our customers
  • Act as subject matter expert for change initiatives and/or cross functional projects taking place across the Aircover Scaled Ops and Optimization org, including assisting internal stakeholders to test, refine, ideate, and deploy new internal products and processes

Your Expertise:

  • 5+  years in a fintech or customer experience role , with a minimum of 1+ years experience handling insurance claims, preferably including first and third party property damage claims
  • Critical thinking skills with a proven track record in solving challenging customer problems and making claims decisions with consistency and fairness whilst adhering to policy terms and workflows
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience interacting with customers through multiple channels including email, messaging and phone 
  • Active listening skills to understand user needs and provide personalized recommendations and assistance
  • Ability to explain complex and sensitive issues to customers with confidence and clarity
  • Analytical skills with the ability to organize and work independently with rapidly changing priorities
  • Negotiation skills to ensure customer issues are resolved in a timely and efficient manner
  • Solution and outcome-oriented with an ability to balance fraud prevention alongside a positive user experience
  • Calm and Empathetic with ability to adapt to any situation by personalizing responses and educating our community whilst remaining level headed in challenging situations
  • A regular work schedule of 5 days per week (40 hours), mutually agreed with your Supervisor, which may include weekend days and company wide / public holidays Travel requirements (if applicable)
  • Preferred skill-sets:
    • Experience working on change initiatives and/or cross-functional projects to meet strategic goals.
    • Experience working with internal stakeholders and third party administrators to resolve complex claims in a detailed, effective and timely manner
    • Proficiency in English and another language

title: Spécialiste AirCover, Expérience client en réclamations
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Airbnb a pris le jour en 2007 lorsque deux Hôtes ont accueilli trois invités dans leur maison de San Francisco, et compte depuis lors plus de 4 millions d'Hôtes qui ont accueilli plus d'un milliard d'invités dans presque tous les pays du monde. Chaque jour, les Hôtes proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux invités de se connecter de manière plus authentique aux communautés.

La communauté que vous rejoindrez : 

L’équipe AirCover a pour mandat de concevoir, de bâtir, de lancer et de gérer les activités d’AirCover au sein d’Airbnb. Nous avons une grande responsabilité envers notre communauté d’hôtes et de voyageurs : être là lorsque les choses ne se déroulent pas exactement comme prévu avec leurs réservations. Les défis seront nombreux au cours des prochaines années, et nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne pour nous aider à coordonner nos priorités et à offrir une expérience irréprochable à notre communauté.

L’équipe Claims Experience fait partie de l’équipe AirCover. Elle offre un soutien haut de gamme à nos utilisateurs en adaptant l’expérience et les services proposés à leurs besoins particuliers, afin que chacun puisse accueillir des voyageurs et voyager en toute confiance. Nous cultivons une compréhension et une empathie profondes envers les attentes de chacun de nos clients, et nous allons au-delà des attentes pour créer des interactions personnalisées qui laissent une impression durable tout au long du processus de réclamation, du début à la fin.

L’équipe assure la réussite opérationnelle de l’ensemble des produits AirCover et offre une exécution sans faille grâce à la qualité et à la rapidité de nos échanges, tout en veillant à la fidélisation de la clientèle et à la croissance continue de notre communauté Airbnb.

La différence que vous ferez :

Vous aurez pour mandat de comprendre les besoins uniques de nos clients et d’aller au-delà des attentes pour créer des interactions personnalisées qui laissent une impression durable tout au long du processus de réclamation, du début à la fin.

Vous traiterez nos clients avec cohérence, équité et empathie, de sorte qu’ils se sentent écoutés et compris. Vous adapterez le soutien offert à leurs besoins particuliers afin de régler les problèmes efficacement, à la satisfaction de toutes les parties. En améliorant l’expérience client de bout en bout, vous contribuerez à accroître les taux de fidélisation et à permettre à chacun d’accueillir des voyageurs et de voyager sur Airbnb en toute confiance.

Une journée typique : 

  • Évaluer, examiner et régler les réclamations soumises pour les produits AirCover (y compris, sans s’y limiter, les réclamations liées à la protection des hôtes contre les dommages), notamment des réclamations de valeur élevée et de grande complexité qui exigent des enquêtes approfondies et des négociations pour en arriver à des résultats satisfaisants
  • Surveiller de près les indices de fraude et atténuer les risques associés aux individus malveillants afin de protéger la marque Airbnb et sa communauté
  • Vérifier tous les faits et éléments de preuve pertinents pour déterminer l’issue de chaque dossier, dans le respect des politiques et des processus internes
  • Aller au-delà des attentes pour créer des interactions personnalisées et offrir un soutien haut de gamme exceptionnel tout au long du processus de réclamation, en adaptant l’expérience proposée et en veillant à répondre aux besoins et aux préférences de chaque utilisateur avec le plus grand soin et la plus grande attention
  • Renseigner et guider continuellement les utilisateurs au sujet de nos produits, de nos conditions et de nos politiques AirCover afin de faciliter le règlement de leurs demandes
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes et les administrateurs de réclamations tiers afin de s’entendre sur les stratégies de traitement des dossiers et d’assurer un règlement rapide pour nos utilisateurs
  • Communiquer régulièrement avec les superviseurs et le gestionnaire pour faire le point sur l’état des réclamations
  • Maintenir un haut niveau de confidentialité pendant les enquêtes
  • Cerner les lacunes dans les processus, les méthodes de travail ou les politiques, et transmettre des commentaires aux échelons supérieurs au besoin afin d’améliorer continuellement l’expérience de nos clients
  • Agir à titre d’expert ou d’experte en la matière pour les initiatives de changement et les projets interfonctionnels de l’organisation Aircover Scaled Ops and Optimization, notamment en aidant les parties prenantes internes à mettre à l’essai, à peaufiner, à concevoir et à déployer de nouveaux produits et processus internes

Votre expertise :

  • 5 ans ou plus d’expérience dans le secteur de la technologie financière (fintech) ou dans un rôle axé sur l’expérience client, dont au moins 1 an en traitement de réclamations d’assurance, idéalement des réclamations pour dommages matériels, tant de l’assuré que de tiers
  • Esprit critique et capacité éprouvée à résoudre des problèmes clients complexes et à rendre des décisions d’indemnisation de façon cohérente et équitable, dans le respect des modalités des polices et des processus établis
  • Excellentes communication à l’oral et à l’écrit, et expérience des échanges avec la clientèle par divers canaux, dont le courriel, la messagerie et le téléphone
  • Écoute active afin de cerner les besoins des utilisateurs et de leur offrir des recommandations et de l’aide personnalisées
  • Capacité d’expliquer avec assurance et clarté des enjeux complexes et délicats aux clients
  • Capacités analytiques, sens de l’organisation et capacité de travailler de façon autonome dans un contexte où les priorités changent rapidement
  • Habiletés de négociation pour régler les problèmes des clients rapidement et efficacement
  • Orientation vers les solutions et les résultats, avec la capacité d’équilibrer la prévention de la fraude et une expérience utilisateur positive
  • Calme et empathie, avec la capacité de s’adapter à toute situation en personnalisant les réponses et en renseignant notre communauté, tout en gardant son sang-froid dans les situations difficiles
  • Un horaire de travail régulier de 5 jours par semaine (40 heures), établi d’un commun accord avec votre superviseur, qui inclut des fins de semaine ainsi que des jours fériés, y compris ceux de l’entreprise. Déplacements (s’il y a lieu)
    • Expérience de la conduite d’initiatives de changement ou de projets interfonctionnels visant l’atteinte d’objectifs stratégiques
    • Expérience de collaboration avec des parties prenantes internes et des administrateurs tiers pour régler des réclamations complexes de façon rigoureuse, efficace et rapide
    • Une maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit; la connaissance de toute autre langue constitue un atout.

Votre emplacement :

En raison de la nature de ce poste, le candidat retenu devra être basé au Canada pour pouvoir effectuer son travail. Actuellement, les employés peuvent être situés dans : la Colombie-Britannique, l’Ontario, le Québec, l’Alberta ou le Saskatchewan. Cette liste est continuellement mise à jour, veuillez vérifier avec nous si les provinces dans lesquelles vous vivez figurent sur la liste. Si votre poste est employé par une autre entité Airbnb, votre recruteur vous informera des provinces dans lesquelles vous êtes éligible pour travailler.

Notre engagement envers l’inclusion et l’appartenance :

Airbnb s'engage à travailler avec le vivier de talents le plus large possible. Nous pensons que la diversité des idées favorise l’innovation et l’engagement, et nous permet d’attirer des personnes créatives et de développer les meilleurs produits, services et solutions. Toutes les personnes qualifiées sont encouragées à postuler.

Nous nous efforçons également de proposer un processus de candidature et d'entretien inclusif pour les personnes handicapées. Si vous êtes un candidat handicapé et avez besoin d'aménagements raisonnables pour soumettre une candidature, veuillez nous contacter à l'adresse : raisonnableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Veuillez inclure votre nom complet, le poste pour lequel vous postulez et les aménagements nécessaires pour vous aider dans le processus de recrutement. 

Nous vous demandons de nous contacter uniquement si vous êtes un candidat dont le handicap vous empêche de remplir notre candidature en ligne.

Nous utilisons des outils automatisés pour aider notre équipe de recrutement à examiner efficacement un grand nombre de candidatures. Toutes les décisions finales d’embauche sont prises par une personne humaine.

Ce poste correspond à un poste vacant au sein de l'organisation.

title: Senior Counsel, Product Privacy
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Airbnb’s Legal Department is a global team that will require working with diverse international colleagues around the world. The successful candidate will be someone who is adaptable, collaborative and embodies Airbnb’s Core Values. Candidates will be required to approach complex legal issues with a balance for local and global perspectives, while being adaptable to cultural differences and nuances. A genuine and demonstrated interest in Airbnb and a commitment to ethics, integrity and fostering a workplace that emphasizes diversity and belonging is a must.

The Community You Will Join: 

Airbnb is seeking a business-oriented Senior Counsel with deep experience in global privacy laws and regulatory compliance to join our growing legal team. 

The Difference You Will Make:

You will play a critical role within our global privacy and cybersecurity legal team, and work across multiple global teams and regions providing support and advice to Airbnb’s business. You must have excellent judgment in balancing legal risks with business strategy and a proven ability to learn new areas of law and function independently in a demanding fast-paced environment. We’re looking for a highly adaptable and collaborative person who can handle ambiguity and rapidly shifting priorities with flexibility, patience, and poise.

A Typical Day:

  • Serves as the primary privacy legal advisor for Payments and Insurance processes and products globally, shaping how privacy legal requirements are embedded into these products and processes, including advising on the privacy implications of payment processing, payouts, financial product features, and fraud prevention systems across all markets, as well as advising on all privacy legal aspects related to Airbnb's Insurance products, including AirCover, Host Protection Insurance, and related coverage programs.
  • Advises on the intersection of privacy law and payments and insurance obligations globally,   including PCI-DSS adjacencies, state and national financial privacy laws in the US, and international payment data requirements, as well as on the regulatory intersection of insurance laws  and privacy laws across key markets, where insurance regulation introduces specific obligations,  working in close coordination with Payments Legal, Payments Compliance, Insurance Legal, and regional Counsels where required.
  • Advises Commercial Legal in negotiating commercial contracts with payment processors and insurance providers.
  • Acts as a key cross-functional influencer with Payments and Insurance Legal and Privacy Management teams to identify and articulate privacy legal risks, requirements, and tradeoffs early in the product lifecycle.
  • Partners closely with the Lead Counsel, Product Privacy,  Privacy Managers, Payments and Insurance Legal, compliance teams and regional product privacy counsels to align privacy guidance across geographies, ensuring consistent standards and localized compliance.
  • Monitors and advises on privacy legal and regulatory requirements related to data privacy requirements and supports associated compliance strategies for payments and insurance products and processing, including with respect to U.S. and other global privacy laws.
  • Provides advice and counsel to the Privacy Operations team on the implementation of global privacy compliance requirements related to data governance and data lifecycle management projects.

Your Expertise:

  • 8+ years of privacy law experience with depth in financial data privacy, payments, or insurance-adjacent regulatory contexts.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on global payments or financial services data practices in a B2C or platform context.
  • Experience working across legal, compliance, and commercial functions in a matrixed organization.

Technical / Domain Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of the intersection of privacy law and financial data regulation, including CCPA, GLBA, PCI-DSS adjacencies, and equivalent international frameworks.
  • Familiarity with insurance data regulatory requirements and how they intersect with global privacy law across key markets.
  • Ability to advise on data minimization, legal basis, and transparency requirements for complex financial and insurance product features.

Leadership & Communication:

  • Ability to influence across product, payments, legal, and compliance stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to synthesize complex regulatory intersections into clear, actionable product guidance.
  • Comfortable managing a broad, global scope across two distinct product verticals simultaneously.

title: Systems Engineer, Tech Foundations (Jira cloud)
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention. We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.
Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Systems Engineer is a hands-on builder who moves fast, delivers with quality, and uses AI as a force multiplier in day-to-day work. In this role, you will configure, maintain, and continuously improve Airbnb's Atlassian platforms, and you will own end-to-end delivery of defined projects within the Jira Data Center deprecation and transition to Jira Cloud. You will work autonomously on projects that span several components and may not be fully defined, partnering with senior engineers and your manager to shape the details. You will spot where AI and automation can reduce toil and improve reliability for the teams we serve, then build those improvements. You bring solid platform knowledge, sound technical judgment within your domain, and the curiosity to grow toward senior-level scope.

A Typical Day:

  • Administer Jira Cloud Software (JSW), Jira Cloud Service Management (JSM), and associated Atlassian tooling; take ownership of assigned parts of the environment to improve reliability and quality, following established configuration standards and governance
  • Design and implement Jira configurations including custom workflows, issue type hierarchies, permission schemes, notification schemes, screens, and field configurations aligned with Atlassian best practices, contributing independently to designs and seeking senior review where needed
  • Deliver end-to-end migration workstreams within the Jira Data Center to Cloud program, such as migrating a set of projects or a configuration domain, coordinating with stakeholders on cutover readiness
  • Configure Jira Service Management projects including SLAs, custom queues, JSM Forms, approval workflows, and security schemes to support internal service delivery teams
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting using native Jira Cloud tooling; Airbnb has elected to avoid Atlassian Marketplace products for information security, privacy, and legal reasons. Support and maintain Airbnb's custom Forge applications in partnership with supporting systems engineering teams
  • Support Atlassian access management, user lifecycle management, and license hygiene, and contribute to security posture improvements
  • Partner with business stakeholders in requirements-gathering sessions, translate needs into configuration and automation solutions, and proactively highlight issues or risks in the work
  • Configure Atlassian Rovo AI agents and automation rules; evaluate trade-offs between delivery speed and long-term sustainability, and apply AI responsibly and in context
  • Write and maintain automation rules using Jira's native Automation engine and JavaScript; use the Jira REST API for integrations, data imports, and custom reporting
  • Support testing cycles for platform changes and migrations; write and run test scripts, track defects, and ensure a rollback plan is in place before changes ship
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, standups) for platform-focused workstreams
  • Keep system configurations, runbooks, and knowledge base articles up to date to support operational continuity and self-service
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, respond to Atlassian platform incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews
  • Identify and reduce technical debt over time; provide constructive input in design and configuration reviews, and help teammates learn through specific examples and timely feedback
  • Participate in hiring and onboarding, delivering clear and timely feedback on candidates

Your Expertise:

  • BE/B.Tech or relevant technical degree
  • 3+ years of hands-on Atlassian administration experience, including Jira Software and Jira Service Management (Jira Cloud) in enterprise environments
  • Solid working knowledge of Jira workflow design, including post functions, validators, and conditions; strong command of JQL for filters, subscriptions, dashboards, and board configuration
  • Hands-on experience contributing to Jira migrations (Data Center to Cloud), including project configuration migration and data integrity validation
  • Experience configuring Jira Cloud native tooling for reporting and planning
  • Flexible to work in USA overlapping work hours 
  • Hands-on experience with the Jira REST API using tools like Postman (GET/PUT/POST) for data extraction, integration, and reporting; maintaining integration touchpoints with AtlassianCloud through service account creation & management
  • Familiarity with integrating Atlassian tools with identity providers such as Okta and LDAP, and with user lifecycle and license management practices
  • Exposure to Atlassian Rovo or other AI/ML capabilities in the Atlassian ecosystem, with an interest in applying AI thoughtfully and ethically
  • Experience building Jira Automation rules; working knowledge of JavaScript and JSON for custom automation
  • Working experience with Jira Service Management, including SLA configuration, JSM Forms, custom queues, and approval workflows
  • Experience writing and executing test scripts and documenting defects for platform changes or migrations
  • Familiarity with Agile practices; SAFe or Scrum certification is a plus
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical work to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to deliver autonomously in a remote-first, fast-moving environment and keep stakeholders informed of progress and blockers
  • Familiarity with complementary enterprise tools such as Slack, Asana, Figma, Airtable, and Miro is an advantage

Our mission is to make every Airbnb engineer's day better by building world-class developer infrastructure that removes friction and provides the tools to unlock their best work. title: Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Cities team leads the work necessary to implement the regulatory products and processes needed globally to comply with regulations, and does so in a manner that also sustainably supports Airbnb's growth.

Within Cities, this role owns Airbnb's platform regulatory compliance program across EMEA — the growing set of EU and UK obligations that sit alongside, and increasingly beyond, short-term rental regulation.

The Difference You Will Make

As Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA, you are the accountable owner for a portfolio of platform regulations that is expanding in scope, scrutiny, and consequence — including the Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act, and more.

You will translate each obligation into a durable operating process, a defensible reporting methodology, or a product change — and serve as a trusted advisor to Legal, Policy, and Product leadership on how Airbnb meets its regulatory commitments in the region.

A Typical Day: 

  • Own the EMEA compliance portfolio. Establish the operating processes and documentation that sustain obligations at scale, and report and monitor status and risk.
  • Deliver regulatory reporting and submissions. Own the annual and ad hoc reporting calendar end to end. Deliver against regulatory deadlines, and iterate so each cycle is faster and more defensible than the last.
  • Assess obligations and strengthen assurance. Identify new and changing obligations early, evaluate our readiness against them, and recommend the measures required to meet them. 
  • Translate regulatory requirements into scalable solutions. Define the product, engineering, and data requirements needed to meet obligations at scale, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap, sequence delivery, and validate outcomes against compliance standards.

Your Expertise: 

  • 12+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, compliance program management, or regulatory operations — preferably in a technology platform or another highly regulated industry.
  • Proven track record owning a multi-jurisdiction, cross-functional compliance program end to end, with direct experience across the Digital Services Act, and the UK Online Safety Act. 
  • Hands-on experience with a recurring regulator-facing reporting cycle and the relationship management that comes with it.
  • Track record partnering with Product and Engineering to deliver regulatory requirements into live products.
  • Data fluency to define, own, and defend a reporting methodology to auditors and regulators.
  • Familiarity with regulatory technology and automation tools.
  • Ability to operate with a strategic lens—connecting regulatory requirements to long-term business objectives and functional roadmaps.
  • Excellent communicator and negotiator; able to transform ambiguity into clarity, and move from complexity to consensus.
  • Strong analytical skills and an ability to design operational structures that balance compliance, risk, and scalability.
  • Proven leadership growing and coaching high-performing, diverse teams; comfortable leading through influence as well as structure.
