title: Senior Lead Quality, Global English
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

The Quality Lead for Global English supports the largest segment of Airbnb's Community Support partner network, the Global English Volume Tier. This lead oversees the day-to-day quality operation across multiple BPO partners, spanning Resolutions 1, 2, and 3, Dedicated Service Support, Services & Experiences, Dedicated Managed Host Support, and Review Integrity, across roughly 5,000+ GE-language agents globally.

The Difference You Will Make:

This is an execution and leadership role. The Quality Lead is responsible for making the quality program work on the ground: ensuring partner QA teams are calibrated and accountable, translating quality standards into partner behavior, surfacing performance trends early, and driving the actions that close gaps. This Lead will also mentor a group of Partner Quality Leads, who work directly with partners to manage and drive performance; this individual will also work directly with Quality Leaders across our different partners supporting Global English. This Lead will direct the focus and energy of these teams toward what matters, remove blockers, help address areas of opportunity, and hold the overall GE quality program to a consistent standard.

A Typical Day: 

GE Quality Program Execution

  • Own the day-to-day execution of the GE quality program across all Volume Tier service lines (R1, R2, R3, DSS, S&E, DMHS, RIT) and all GE partner sites.
  • Ensure weekly QA evaluation targets are met across all sites and service lines; monitor evaluation completeness, calibration accuracy, and coaching activity within the GE portfolio.
  • Maintain the weekly QA performance reporting cadence, ensuring partner QA teams and Partner Operations Managers receive timely, accurate, and actionable quality data each week.

Partner Network Governance & Accountability

  • Hold GE partner QA teams accountable to the Performance Scorecard results: Agent Saturation Targets, Evaluation Completeness, Calibration Accuracy, Coaching Effectiveness, Actionable Insights.
  • Maintain regular engagement with Partner Quality teams: weekly alignment cadences and alignment on monthly business reviews results and actions.
  • Escalate partner performance gaps and establish documented action plans where warranted; escalation to the Sr. Leadership for situations that require escalation.
  • Manage the New Site Onboarding process for any new GE partner sites that come online, ensuring they are calibrated to GE quality standards before they scale.

Calibration & Alignment

  • Conduct calibration sessions across GE partner sites; ensure calibration rigor, so that GE quality is being measured consistently regardless of partner or geography.
  • Drive QA alignment across Quality and Delivery teams. 

Insights, NPS Correlation & the AQS North Star

  • Oversee NPS Detractor Analysis Insights, to identify drivers of dissatisfaction; work with Delivery, Training, and other stakeholders to address areas of opportunity. 
  • Correlate quality results to operational outcomes and KPIs; place quality focus and emphasis accordingly, based on operational measures that require attention. 
  • Ensure GE quality insights are integrated into the weekly partner performance narrative: when scores drop week-over-week, understand drivers and root cause; be able to explain in weekly reviews. 

Cross-Functional Initiatives

  • Partner with the GE Training team on critical initiatives, such as Training Flight Simulator and AirReady; Quality's role is to ensure training artifacts related to Quality are aligned to to our Lead With Hospitality framework.
  • Participate as the GE quality voice in cross-functional working groups, where quality findings have direct implications for process or content change. 
  • Surface patterns from GE evaluations that signal policy gaps, workflow failures, or product issues — not just agent-level coaching opportunities. When the same investigation error appears across three different partner sites in the same week, that is a systemic issue that belongs in OneTrack, not a coaching note.

Reporting & Operational Cadences

  • Own the GE contribution to the global Quality reporting framework: weekly KPI data by site and language (NPS, Reopen Rate, AQS, 0–60, Throughput) submitted accurately and on time as part of the automated reporting rollout, replacing the current manual slide validation process.
  • Ensure GE partner sites are submitting their own KPI narratives with substance — not high-level summaries or incorrect figures. The QI Lead's job is to verify narrative quality, not just numbers; this role's job is to ensure that standard is held across all five partner networks.
  • Maintain the GE calendar of quality touchpoints: weekly partner performance reviews, monthly calibration sessions, monthly partner business reviews, and quarterly COPC-style partner capability assessments — and ensure the QI Lead team is prepared and present for each.

Your Expertise:

  • 8+ years of experience in Community/Customer Support Quality, Operations, or a related field, with direct experience managing QA programs across BPO or partner networks.
  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably in related field required.
  • Demonstrated experience driving partner BPO accountability: running calibration sessions, managing partner QA scorecards, writing and executing improvement plans, and holding BPO QA managers to performance standards in a governance context.
  • Working knowledge of COPC methodology; able to apply COPC evaluation standards, sampling requirements, and calibration governance in a live multi-partner operational environment.
  • Strong analytical skills: able to read weekly QA performance data, diagnose root causes behind score movements (tenure mix, calibration drift, form changes, workflow updates), and translate that diagnosis into a clear narrative for Delivery and partner leadership.
  • Experience with QA tooling platforms — Observe.AI, NICE QC, or equivalent — including form design, calibration management, and partner site onboarding.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to write a sharp partner performance email, run a productive calibration session across time zones, and present quality findings to senior Delivery stakeholders with confidence.

Preferred

  • Experience in a BPO or multi-site QA role, either in-house at a BPO or as a client-side quality manager managing multiple BPO partners simultaneously.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent structured problem-solving background.
  • Background working with analytics teams on QA-to-NPS or QA-to-CSAT correlation analysis; experience using AQS (Ambassador Quality Score) or equivalent composite agent performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with cross-functional quality improvement programs — investigation skills initiatives, coaching ambassador programs, agent messaging tone efforts — and experience coordinating quality's role in multi-team rollouts.

title: Responsable principal(e) de la qualité, anglais mondial
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

La communauté que vous allez rejoindre :Le ou la responsable de l’assurance qualité pour le volet anglophone mondial (Global English, ou GE) appuie le segment le plus important du réseau de partenaires du soutien à la communauté d’Airbnb, soit le palier volume en anglais. Cette personne supervise les activités quotidiennes de qualité auprès de plusieurs partenaires de sous-traitance des processus d’affaires (BPO). Elle couvre Résolutions 1, 2 et 3, le Soutien de service dédié, Services et Expériences, le Soutien dédié aux hôtes gérés et l’Intégrité des avis, pour environ 5 000 agents ou plus de langue GE à l’échelle mondiale.

La différence que vous ferez :Il s’agit d’un rôle d’exécution et de leadership. La personne responsable de la qualité doit faire fonctionner le programme de qualité sur terrain : s’assurer que les équipes d’assurance qualité (AQ) des partenaires sont calibrées et responsables, traduire les normes de qualité en comportements chez les partenaires, déceler tôt les tendances de rendement et mener les actions qui comblent les écarts. Elle agira aussi comme mentor auprès d’un groupe de responsables de la qualité des partenaires, qui travaillent directement avec les partenaires pour gérer et améliorer le rendement. Elle travaillera également en collaboration directe avec les dirigeants de la qualité de nos différents partenaires qui soutiennent l’anglais mondial. Elle orientera l’attention et l’énergie de ces équipes vers ce qui compte, éliminera les obstacles, aidera à cerner les occasions d’amélioration et maintiendra l’ensemble du programme de qualité GE selon une norme uniforme.

Une journée type :

Exécution du programme de qualité GE

  • Assurer l’exécution quotidienne du programme de qualité GE pour toutes les gammes de services du palier de volume (R1, R2, R3, DSS, S&E, DMHS, RIT) et pour tous les sites partenaires GE.
  • Veiller à ce que les cibles hebdomadaires d’évaluation AQ soient atteintes dans tous les sites et toutes les gammes de services; surveiller l’exhaustivité des évaluations, la précision de la calibration et les activités d’accompagnement (coaching) au sein du portefeuille GE.
  • Maintenir la cadence hebdomadaire des rapports sur le rendement AQ, afin que les équipes AQ des partenaires et les gestionnaires des opérations des partenaires reçoivent chaque semaine des données de qualité à jour, exactes et exploitables.

Gouvernance du réseau de partenaires et responsabilisation

  • Responsabiliser les équipes AQ des partenaires GE à l’égard des résultats de la fiche de rendement : cibles de saturation des agents, exhaustivité des évaluations, précision de la calibration, efficacité de l’accompagnement et perspectives exploitables.
  • Maintenir un engagement régulier avec les équipes de qualité des partenaires : rencontres hebdomadaires d’harmonisation et harmonisation sur les résultats et les actions issus des revues d’affaires mensuelles.
  • Faire remonter les écarts de rendement des partenaires et établir des plans d’action documentés lorsque la situation le justifie; saisir la haute direction des situations qui l’exigent.
  • Gérer le processus d’intégration de tout nouveau site partenaire GE qui entre en service, en veillant à ce qu’il soit calibré selon les normes de qualité GE avant son expansion.

Calibration et harmonisation

  • Mener des séances de calibration auprès des sites partenaires GE; assurer la rigueur de la calibration afin que la qualité GE soit mesurée de façon uniforme, peu importe le partenaire ou la région géographique.
  • Favoriser l’harmonisation de l’AQ entre les équipes de la qualité et celles de la prestation de services.

Perspectives, corrélation avec le NPS et indicateur phare AQS

  • Superviser l’analyse des détracteurs du NPS afin de cerner les causes d’insatisfaction; collaborer avec la prestation de services, la formation et les autres parties prenantes pour tirer parti des occasions d’amélioration.
  • Établir la corrélation entre les résultats de qualité, les résultats opérationnels et les indicateurs clés de rendement (ICR); orienter l’attention et les efforts de qualité en conséquence, selon les mesures opérationnelles qui exigent une attention particulière.
  • Veiller à ce que les perspectives de qualité GE soient intégrées au récit hebdomadaire du rendement des partenaires : lorsque les scores baissent d’une semaine à l’autre, comprendre les facteurs et la cause fondamentale, et être en mesure de les expliquer lors des revues hebdomadaires.

Initiatives interfonctionnelles

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe de formation GE sur des initiatives clés, comme le Training Flight Simulator et AirReady; le rôle de la qualité est de s’assurer que les documents de formation liés à la qualité sont alignés sur notre cadre Lead With Hospitality.
  • Agir à titre de porte-parole de la qualité GE au sein des groupes de travail interfonctionnels, lorsque les constats de qualité ont des répercussions directes sur des changements de processus ou de contenu.
  • Dégager des évaluations GE les tendances qui signalent des lacunes de politique, des défaillances de flux de travail ou des problèmes de produit, et pas seulement des occasions d’accompagnement individuel. Lorsque la même erreur d’enquête apparaît dans trois sites partenaires différents au cours de la même semaine, il s’agit d’un problème systémique qui doit être consigné dans OneTrack, et non d’une simple note d’accompagnement.

Rapports et cadences opérationnelles

  • Être responsable de la contribution de GE au cadre mondial de production de rapports sur la qualité : données hebdomadaires sur les ICR par site et par langue (NPS, taux de réouverture, AQS, 0-60, débit de traitement), soumises de façon exacte et dans les délais dans le cadre du déploiement des rapports automatisés, qui remplace le processus actuel de validation manuelle des diapositives.
  • S’assurer que les sites partenaires GE soumettent leurs propres récits sur les ICR, et que ceux-ci sont substantiels, et non de simples résumés généraux ou des chiffres inexacts. Le rôle du ou de la responsable QI est de vérifier la qualité du récit, et pas seulement les chiffres; ce poste doit veiller à ce que cette norme soit respectée dans les cinq réseaux de partenaires.
  • Maintenir le calendrier GE des points de contact de qualité : revues hebdomadaires du rendement des partenaires, séances mensuelles de calibration, revues d’affaires mensuelles des partenaires et évaluations trimestrielles des capacités des partenaires de type COPC; veiller à ce que l’équipe des responsables QI soit préparée et présente à chacune d’elles.

Votre expertise :

  • 8 ans ou plus d’expérience en qualité, en exploitation ou dans un domaine connexe du soutien à la communauté ou à la clientèle, dont une expérience directe de la gestion de programmes d’AQ au sein de réseaux d'impartition de processus d'affaires ( BPO) ou de partenaires.
  • Baccalauréat exigé, de préférence dans un domaine connexe.
  • Expérience démontrée de la responsabilisation des partenaires d’impartition de processus d’affaires (BPO) : animation de séances de calibration, gestion des fiches de rendement AQ des partenaires, rédaction et exécution de plans d’amélioration, et responsabilisation des gestionnaires AQ des d'impartition de processus d'affaires ( BPO) à l’égard des normes de rendement dans un contexte de gouvernance.
  • Connaissance pratique de la méthodologie COPC; capacité d’appliquer les normes d’évaluation, les exigences d’échantillonnage et la gouvernance de la calibration de COPC dans un environnement opérationnel réel regroupant plusieurs partenaires.
  • Solides compétences analytiques : capacité d’interpréter les données hebdomadaires de rendement AQ, de diagnostiquer les causes fondamentales des variations de scores (composition de l’ancienneté, dérive de calibration, changements de formulaire, mises à jour de flux de travail) et de transformer ce diagnostic en un récit clair pour la prestation de services et la direction des partenaires.
  • Expérience des plateformes d’outils d’AQ, comme Observe.AI, NICE QC ou équivalent, y compris la conception de formulaires, la gestion de la calibration et l’intégration de sites partenaires.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à la communication écrite et orale; capacité de rédiger un courriel clair et percutant sur le rendement d’un partenaire, d’animer une séance de calibration productive à travers plusieurs fuseaux horaires et de présenter avec assurance les constats de qualité à des parties prenantes seniors de la prestation de services.

Atouts

  • Expérience dans un rôle d’assurance qualité au sein d'une entreprise d'impartition de processus d'affaires (BPO) ou dans un environnement multisite, que ce soit à l’interne chez un fournisseur d'impartition de processus d'affaires (BPO) ou du côté client en tant que gestionnaire de la qualité supervisant simultanément plusieurs partenaires d'impartition de processus d'affaires (BPO).
  • Certification Ceinture verte Six Sigma (Six Sigma Green Belt) ou profil équivalent en résolution structurée de problèmes.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes d'analytique sur l'analyse de corrélation entre l'assurance qualité et les indicateurs NPS ou CSAT; expérience d'utilisation de l'AQS (Ambassador Quality Score) ou de mesures composites équivalentes du rendement des agents.
  • Très bonne connaissance des programmes interfonctionnels d'amélioration de la qualité d’initiatives axées sur les compétences d'enquête, programmes de coaching des ambassadeurs, harmonisation du ton des communications des agents, et expérience de coordination du volet qualité lors de déploiements transversaux entre plusieurs équipes.

Votre emplacement :

En raison de la nature de ce poste, le candidat retenu devra être basé au Canada pour pouvoir effectuer son travail. Actuellement, les employés peuvent être situés dans : la Colombie-Britannique, l'Ontario, le Québec, l'Alberta ou le Saskatchewan. Cette liste est continuellement mise à jour, veuillez vérifier avec nous si les provinces dans lesquelles vous vivez figurent sur la liste. Si votre poste est employé par une autre entité Airbnb, votre recruteur vous informera des provinces dans lesquelles vous êtes éligible pour travailler.

title: Business Process Improvement Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

The Business Process Improvement team focuses on improving processes across all Community Support. Our team is a global team of process improvement professionals, who help bring cross functional partners from across CS and Airbnb together to operationalize new processes, analyze current process for improvement opportunities, and scale solutions across a global network. We follow general business process engineering principles and practices, as well as leveraging Lean Six Sigma methodologies in our improvement projects.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Business Process Manager will be a senior individual contributor within the Service Optimization team, part of the Community Service Organization. This role advances the team's process engineering discipline by designing systems where problems do not occur, rather than only improving processes that already exist. The Business Process Manager delivers through deep individual expertise: applying systems thinking, engineering processes for AI-readiness and automation by default, and building AI prototypes to test and validate new process designs before full implementation. This is a role for a senior level practitioner who operates at the intersection of process engineering, systems design, and applied AI.

A Typical Day: 

  • Develop business strategies within Service Optimization and Community Support across people, process, and technology.
  • Lead the operationalization of strategies across Community Support and other cross functional teams such as Policy, Finance, and Product.
  • Lead complex, large-scale, cross-functional process engineering initiatives from problem definition through measurable outcomes, applying the full suite of Lean Six Sigma tools and a structured process engineering framework across four disciplines: understanding the problem and its system context, designing reliable and measurable solutions, grounding those solutions in operational reality, and evolving them as conditions change.
  • Apply and coach others to apply a systems thinking lens to every problem: map full upstream and downstream context before prescribing solutions, identifying where the real problem lives rather than where it surfaces.
  • Design processes for AI-readiness and automation by default, engineering every future state around three standards: does it reduce agent and customer burden, is it measurable from day one, and can it be automated or self-correcting over time.
  • Build AI prototypes to communicate and validate process designs, using AI tools, workflow automation platforms, and lightweight modeling approaches to test the viability of new process architectures before committing to full implementation.
  • Use process simulation to model how a designed process will behave under real-world conditions, stress-testing assumptions about volume, variation, and failure modes before a design is deployed.
  • Develop and continuously improve process designs of Community Support experiences that document the full interaction across the customer journey, agent processes, product features, and policies, informing multi-year roadmap planning.
  • Implement process measurement systems from the start of every design: establish KPIs, deploy statistical process control methods, and track outcomes post-launch to confirm improvements hold.
  • Lead change management for process transitions, ensuring new designs are adopted effectively by agents, teams, and partners and that improvements are sustained over time.
  • Build and scale process engineering competency, systems thinking, and AI-ready design, contributing to capability building across the team.
  • Partner with Product and Technology teams to translate process requirements into tooling specifications, ensuring AI and other product capabilities are engineered around how agents and customers actually work.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Analytics, and Operations to align priorities and drive trade-off decisions grounded in data.
  • Communicate progress and findings to senior leadership, distilling complex analysis into clear narratives with a line of sight to measurable outcomes

Your Expertise:

  • Preferred Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of post-graduate experience in operations, process management, or process improvement, with at least 7 years in a customer support operations environment (preferred).
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certified or equivalent process engineering expertise. Additional consideration given to Agile, service design, and Industrial and Systems Engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to build AI prototypes and proof-of-concept workflow automations: practical experience using AI tools, no-code or low-code platforms, or scripting to test and validate process designs before full implementation.
  • Demonstrated mastery to design processes for AI-readiness and automation, engineering systems that evolve with AI capabilities rather than simply optimizing existing workflows.
  • Proven experience applying systems thinking to process design, identifying root causes upstream and tracing impacts downstream before prescribing solutions.
  • Advanced statistical and data-driven analytical skills, including statistical process control methods, regression analysis, and measurement system analysis.
  • Experience using process simulation tools to model process behavior, test design assumptions, and predict outcomes under varying conditions prior to implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience driving organizational change, including stakeholder alignment, communication planning, and adoption measurement.
  • Proven ability to interact and communicate with people at all levels of the organization, including senior leadership, in an open and transparent manner.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to influence, structure arguments clearly, and drive alignment to measurable outcomes without formal authority.
  • Demonstrated focus on end-to-end customer journey and customer-centric outcomes.
  • Prior experience developing business processes in customer support operating models that balance multiple stakeholder interests.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity with creative problem-solving, strong analytical skills, and a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.
  • Proactive and autonomous: able to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously with minimal direction.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of time.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Experimentation Interfaces
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Experimentation team's mission is to provide an insightful, reliable and easy to use experimentation platform (A/B testing and feature rollout) for customers across the company. Thousands of experiments run on our platform each year. The Difference You Will Make

You will co-own the web application where teams set up, manage and analyze experiments and feature configuration, and the AI-assisted workflows that are becoming part of how experiments are designed, validated and read out. You will build features end to end, from the React/TypeScript interface through Python APIs to the data layer, and make our tools intuitive and trustworthy for users with a wide range of statistical backgrounds. Success looks like features that measurably speed up experiment setup and readout, and AI-enabled tools that people adopt because they are reliable.

  • Develop new features across the client (React/TypeScript), APIs (Python/GraphQL) and database, and own them from design through on-call.

  • Build AI-enabled workflows for our users, such as agent tools and skills that help create, validate and analyze experiments, and the interface around them, with evaluations that keep quality high.
  • Use AI-assisted development to move faster, and help the team set good practice for it.
  • Work with data science partners to bring new methodology into the product.
  • Participate in experiment reviews to understand how customers use the platform and where it falls short.

Your Expertise

  • 5+ years in a hands-on software engineering role, shipping high-quality code to production, including full-stack web applications on a modern stack.
  • Strong front-end skills: React and TypeScript fundamentals, state and data fetching, performance and testing, and a good eye for intuitive interfaces in data-rich or enterprise tools.
  • Experience across the stack: backend APIs in Python or a similar language, GraphQL or comparable API design, and relational database storage.

title: Emergency Response Manager, APAC
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

This position is employed by Airbnb Inc., however the role will provide direct support to Airbnb.org, an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit that focuses on emergency response and provides temporary housing for people in times of crisis. Airbnb.org is governed by an independent Board of Directors and its mission is to provide emergency housing in times of crisis. From Australia to France, hosts have offered to open up their homes and helped provide accommodations to over 250,000 people. Our goal is to exponentially increase Airbnb.org’s reach and impact over the next three years. Learn more at Airbnb.org.

The Difference You Will Make:

You will manage Airbnb.org’s emergency responses in the APAC region but will also be expected to support responses globally as required. You will monitor disasters around the world, decide with your manager when an event meets our activation criteria, stand the response up, and manage it through to close-out.

You will do this work with partners on the ground. Local nonprofits and agencies find displaced people, confirm eligibility, and provide case management. Your job is to make sure those partners are ready before an event, and that during one they have the housing supply, the guidance, and the answers they need. Speed matters, and so does the quality of the placement.

You will run several responses at the same time, in different countries and at different stages. You will keep internal teams and external partners informed before they have to ask. You will work across Operations, Strategic Partnerships, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Finance, and Product to deliver one coordinated response.

Reporting to the Senior Lead of Global Emergency Response, this position requires a background in humanitarian and disaster response operations, strong leadership, and expertise in building effective partnerships with nonprofits and government agencies. Experience in Social Impact for tech companies is a big plus. Much of the work is not defined in advance. You will need to set direction yourself, decide with incomplete information, and move things toward clarity and action. You must also be able to deploy to the field on short notice to manage disaster response programs on the ground if needed. 

A Typical Day: 

  • Monitor global disasters via news, partner alerts, government advisories, and internal signals to assess and recommend responses based on Airbnb.org criteria.
  • Establish, activate, and oversee emergency housing responses in close collaboration with on-the-ground partners responsible for the intake and case management of individuals displaced by disasters.
  • Oversee diverse, simultaneous disaster responses. Set priorities across them, and hold an accurate record of status, spend, and the number of people housed.
  • Proactively communicate status, decisions, and next steps to internal and external cross-functional stakeholders and partners.
  • Manage each response end-to-end: verify partner readiness, determine response size and stay lengths, launch operations, monitor placements, solve issues, and conclude based on clear exit criteria.
  • Manage partnerships (including onboarding new partners and managing existing partners) during active emergencies, and ensuring smooth handoff to the Partnerships team at the conclusion of emergency responses.
  • Promptly answer partner questions during live responses, escalating unresolved ones.
  • Work closely with the Partnerships team to build and manage partnerships with organizations that vet and support guests, while working with our Operations team to optimize housing supply, reduce costs, and maximize positive impact for those affected.
  • Collaborate with the Strategic Partnerships team to unify efforts and amplify our reach in response to major disasters.
  • Enhance operational readiness during non-crisis periods. Sharpen activation criteria and playbooks, pre-position partner agreements, expand 24/7 global coverage, increase team capacity, and advocate for the product features the operation needs.

descriptionHtml:

The Community You Will Join: 

As a Strategic Finance & Analytics Principal supporting Membership, you will partner closely with leaders across business operations, product, analytics, data science, and adjacent Strategic Finance teams to help build and grow the Membership program. This team is responsible for developing and scaling new growth levers for Airbnb. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. 

The Strategic Finance & Analytics team sits at the intersection of finance, strategy, and the business, partnering directly with leaders to decide where Airbnb invests, how we grow, and what we do next. We expect every member of the team to bring a CFO mindset to budget management, producing actionable insights, owning our performance story, and supporting day-to-day execution. 

Why join us:

  • A seat at the table. We're advisors, not just analysts. Our work shapes real decisions, not just decks.
  • A steep learning curve. Small, lean teams and a focus on internal mobility means broad exposure across product and business areas.

If you like ambiguity, moving fast, and building the answer instead of just reporting it, you'll fit right in.

The Difference You Will Make

You will be the strategic finance and analytics lead for Membership, helping leadership decide where to invest, how to size programs, and which levers are worth scaling. You will become the subject matter expert on the economics of these programs: how they drive guest and host behavior, what they cost, and what they return. Because many of these programs are early-stage, the financial and analytical foundation often does not yet exist, so you will define and build it.

This role requires a strong commercial mindset, with the ability to size opportunities, evaluate returns, and translate performance and data insights into clear business implications and strategic recommendations for senior leadership. 

The ideal candidate brings a combination of sharp analytical instincts, business acumen, and the ability to distill complex information into crisp executive-ready stories. You relish the opportunity to roll up their sleeves, and are a self-starter comfortable embracing the adventure of a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. 

A Typical Day:

  • Strategic Insights: Conduct analytical and financial deep dives to inform and shape key decisions. You should be comfortable both leading the work independently and partnering with the cross-functional teams to deliver a joint output. 
  • Investment Decision Support: Build the business cases behind program investments. Size the opportunity, model the returns, and frame tradeoffs so leadership can decide where to place bets and how large they should be.
  • Performance Management: Own performance measurement for Membership programs, including defining KPIs, setting goals and OKRs, and building reporting and forecasting that connect early signals to guest and host outcomes, revenue, and long-term value. Support the planning cadences (annual planning, long-range planning, and monthly or quarterly forecasts).
  • Program Economics and ROI: Develop and pressure-test the economics of programs, including incentive and benefit costs, guest and host response, and incremental impact.
  • Presentations to Leadership: Synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior leadership. Influence cross functional stakeholders to drive alignment on high impact investment and operating decisions.

Your Expertise:

  • Ideally you have 10+ years of relevant finance and analytical experience across a mix of strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, strategy/management consulting, and/or business operations.
  • Superb financial modeling skills and extensive experience with quantitative and qualitative financial analysis, including building business cases and ROI frameworks.
  • Highly proficient in business analytics. You will need to independently extract, analyze, and synthesize large datasets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with audiences at various levels. You enjoy working with fragmented data and insights and synthesizing them into a story with recommendations.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive alignment in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where frameworks are still being built.
  • High ownership, strong judgment, and attention to detail.

descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

The Quality Lead for Global English supports the largest segment of Airbnb's Community Support partner network, the Global English Volume Tier. This lead oversees the day-to-day quality operation across multiple BPO partners, spanning Resolutions 1, 2, and 3, Dedicated Service Support, Services & Experiences, Dedicated Managed Host Support, and Review Integrity, across roughly 5,000+ GE-language agents globally.

The Difference You Will Make:

This is an execution and leadership role. The Quality Lead is responsible for making the quality program work on the ground: ensuring partner QA teams are calibrated and accountable, translating quality standards into partner behavior, surfacing performance trends early, and driving the actions that close gaps. This Lead will also mentor a group of Partner Quality Leads, who work directly with partners to manage and drive performance; this individual will also work directly with Quality Leaders across our different partners supporting Global English. This Lead will direct the focus and energy of these teams toward what matters, remove blockers, help address areas of opportunity, and hold the overall GE quality program to a consistent standard.

A Typical Day: 

GE Quality Program Execution

  • Own the day-to-day execution of the GE quality program across all Volume Tier service lines (R1, R2, R3, DSS, S&E, DMHS, RIT) and all GE partner sites.
  • Ensure weekly QA evaluation targets are met across all sites and service lines; monitor evaluation completeness, calibration accuracy, and coaching activity within the GE portfolio.
  • Maintain the weekly QA performance reporting cadence, ensuring partner QA teams and Partner Operations Managers receive timely, accurate, and actionable quality data each week.

Partner Network Governance & Accountability

  • Hold GE partner QA teams accountable to the Performance Scorecard results: Agent Saturation Targets, Evaluation Completeness, Calibration Accuracy, Coaching Effectiveness, Actionable Insights.
  • Maintain regular engagement with Partner Quality teams: weekly alignment cadences and alignment on monthly business reviews results and actions.
  • Escalate partner performance gaps and establish documented action plans where warranted; escalation to the Sr. Leadership for situations that require escalation.
  • Manage the New Site Onboarding process for any new GE partner sites that come online, ensuring they are calibrated to GE quality standards before they scale.

Calibration & Alignment

  • Conduct calibration sessions across GE partner sites; ensure calibration rigor, so that GE quality is being measured consistently regardless of partner or geography.
  • Drive QA alignment across Quality and Delivery teams. 

Insights, NPS Correlation & the AQS North Star

  • Oversee NPS Detractor Analysis Insights, to identify drivers of dissatisfaction; work with Delivery, Training, and other stakeholders to address areas of opportunity. 
  • Correlate quality results to operational outcomes and KPIs; place quality focus and emphasis accordingly, based on operational measures that require attention. 
  • Ensure GE quality insights are integrated into the weekly partner performance narrative: when scores drop week-over-week, understand drivers and root cause; be able to explain in weekly reviews. 

Cross-Functional Initiatives

  • Partner with the GE Training team on critical initiatives, such as Training Flight Simulator and AirReady; Quality's role is to ensure training artifacts related to Quality are aligned to to our Lead With Hospitality framework.
  • Participate as the GE quality voice in cross-functional working groups, where quality findings have direct implications for process or content change. 
  • Surface patterns from GE evaluations that signal policy gaps, workflow failures, or product issues — not just agent-level coaching opportunities. When the same investigation error appears across three different partner sites in the same week, that is a systemic issue that belongs in OneTrack, not a coaching note.

Reporting & Operational Cadences

  • Own the GE contribution to the global Quality reporting framework: weekly KPI data by site and language (NPS, Reopen Rate, AQS, 0–60, Throughput) submitted accurately and on time as part of the automated reporting rollout, replacing the current manual slide validation process.
  • Ensure GE partner sites are submitting their own KPI narratives with substance — not high-level summaries or incorrect figures. The QI Lead's job is to verify narrative quality, not just numbers; this role's job is to ensure that standard is held across all five partner networks.
  • Maintain the GE calendar of quality touchpoints: weekly partner performance reviews, monthly calibration sessions, monthly partner business reviews, and quarterly COPC-style partner capability assessments — and ensure the QI Lead team is prepared and present for each.

Your Expertise:

  • 8+ years of experience in Community/Customer Support Quality, Operations, or a related field, with direct experience managing QA programs across BPO or partner networks.
  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably in related field required.
  • Demonstrated experience driving partner BPO accountability: running calibration sessions, managing partner QA scorecards, writing and executing improvement plans, and holding BPO QA managers to performance standards in a governance context.
  • Working knowledge of COPC methodology; able to apply COPC evaluation standards, sampling requirements, and calibration governance in a live multi-partner operational environment.
  • Strong analytical skills: able to read weekly QA performance data, diagnose root causes behind score movements (tenure mix, calibration drift, form changes, workflow updates), and translate that diagnosis into a clear narrative for Delivery and partner leadership.
  • Experience with QA tooling platforms — Observe.AI, NICE QC, or equivalent — including form design, calibration management, and partner site onboarding.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to write a sharp partner performance email, run a productive calibration session across time zones, and present quality findings to senior Delivery stakeholders with confidence.

Preferred

  • Experience in a BPO or multi-site QA role, either in-house at a BPO or as a client-side quality manager managing multiple BPO partners simultaneously.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent structured problem-solving background.
  • Background working with analytics teams on QA-to-NPS or QA-to-CSAT correlation analysis; experience using AQS (Ambassador Quality Score) or equivalent composite agent performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with cross-functional quality improvement programs — investigation skills initiatives, coaching ambassador programs, agent messaging tone efforts — and experience coordinating quality's role in multi-team rollouts.

This role sits within Marcomm/Marketing, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Global Partnerships (who own the commercial relationship) as well as Creative, PGM, Comms, and Regional Marketing to bring partner storytelling to life, held to the same bar as Airbnb's own brand campaigns.

The Difference You Will Make

As Lead, Partnership Marketing, you'll own the marketing strategy and execution across Airbnb's partner portfolio — turning each partnership's commercial objective into a compelling marketing plan with clear success measures. You'll be the connective tissue between our partners' brand systems and Airbnb's, building campaigns that live on partner channels while staying integrated with Airbnb's owned storytelling. Success looks like a portfolio of partner campaigns that consistently deliver measurable brand and bookings impact, a scorecard that lets leadership compare performance across partners, and an operating rhythm for partner marketing that didn't exist before you built it.

A Typical Day

  • Build and run marketing campaigns on partner channels — bookable placements, integrations, co-branded content, social, email, and on-site/in-venue activations
  • Act as the day-to-day marketing counterpart to each partner's marketing team, owning the marketing relationship alongside the Partnership Lead who owns the deal
  • Brief and partner with Creative to produce assets sized for partner channels, and manage a two-way approvals path between Airbnb and partner brand teams
  • Maintain a rolling marketing calendar per partner, synced to both the partner's roadmap and Airbnb's central marketing calendar — including multi-year views for anchor partnerships
  • Define and report on the brand metrics that matter per partner, partnering with Business Operations and Finance, and feed findings back into planning
  • Deliver real-time, in-market marketing during live moments like major events and brand activations, often on compressed timelines
  • Represent partner marketing in Airbnb's broader Marketing planning cycles, keeping Partnerships, PGM, Creative, Comms, and Regional Marketing aligned on what's launching, when, and why

Your Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in brand, partner, or integrated marketing, with hands-on campaign delivery — not strategy alone
  • Direct experience marketing with or through external partners, such as co-marketing, sponsorships, brand collaborations, or channel/affiliate marketing
  • A track record running campaigns end-to-end: brief, creative development, approvals, launch, and measurement
  • Strong partner-facing instincts, with the credibility to be the calm, trusted presence in a room with another company's marketing or partnerships team
  • Comfort moving fluidly between brand and performance conversations — able to defend a creative choice and speak to the bookings it drove
  • Experience building process and structure in ambiguous, undefined environments
  • Familiarity with co-branded measurement approaches such as incrementality, brand lift studies, or attribution across partner-owned media is a plus, as is experience with major sports, entertainment, or travel partners and live event activation

title: Senior Accountant, Consolidations
descriptionHtml:

The Community You Will Join: 

We are the Consolidations & Intercompany team within Accounting & Reporting. We consolidate Airbnb's financial results across its global legal entities and manage the intercompany activity that connects them, so the books stay accurate, compliant with US GAAP, and closed on time. You will work across Finance, partnering with Treasury, Tax, and Finance Systems on funding, transfer pricing, and process optimization.

The Difference You Will Make:

As Senior Accountant, Consolidations, you will support the day-to-day and key intercompany and consolidations accounting activities, particularly during month-end close, where success means hitting each business day milestone. You will serve as a resource on intercompany topics across the wider Finance organization, including support for internal and external audit requests. You will challenge how things are done today and carry better ways of working through to implementation, in our processes and in the ones we share with cross-functional partners.

A Typical Day: 

  • Own your assigned close areas from start to finish, preparing and posting monthly intercompany and consolidation journal entries and reconciliations by the close milestone dates, including global funding and settlements, ad hoc cash transfers, recharges, and eliminations like intercompany profit.
  • Prepare and post journal entries for foreign currency transactions, redenominations, and translation adjustments.
  • Work with Treasury on cash pool and intercompany funding accounting, including settlements with FX, accrued and capitalized interest, and reconciliations.
  • Work with Treasury, Tax, and other Controlling teams to clear intercompany imbalances and close blockers, raising risks early with a proposed fix, and serve as a resource on intercompany topics such as consolidation and eliminations (ASC 810), foreign currency, and capital transactions.
  • Keep documentation, workpapers, and SOPs current so the work is repeatable and audit-ready, and respond to internal, external, and statutory audit requests.
  • Cut manual work out of the close. Start with the entries and reconciliations within our team, then take on the processes we share with Tax, Treasury, and other partners, to shorten the close and reduce control risk.
  • Core working hours: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time (11:30 AM to 8:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • Additional flexibility required during month-end close

Your Expertise:

  • BS/BA in Accounting and a CPA or Chartered Accountant.
  • 4+ years of accounting experience, with at least 1 year in month-end close.
  • Experience automating accounting or close work, including using AI tools to drive efficiency gains, and advanced Excel for analyzing large data sets.
  • Experience improving controls and reconciliation processes that keep working as volume and complexity increase.
  • Experience owning an assigned close area or workstream end to end with minimal oversight, and a record of spotting problems early and proposing fixes that go beyond the minimum.
  • Experience learning a new accounting area or system quickly and applying it in a live close, working with partners across Finance to resolve issues, and communicating clearly in English, in writing and verbally.
  • Preferred: public accounting experience; direct intercompany accounting experience, especially capital transactions and FX accounting under US GAAP (ASC 830); SQL or another database query language; experience with a large-scale ERP.

The Regional Workplace Operations Manager sits at the intersection of workplace experience, events, and gathering & culture. This role is responsible for bringing our brand to life by creating an intentional, welcoming, and high-functioning office experience that enables employees, leaders, and guests to feel connected, productive, and inspired. Just like our hosts can offer differentiated experiences to our guests, our Regional Workplace Operations Manager exemplifies those aspirational expectations. 

This role serves as the connective tissue across office operations, hospitality, employee engagement, and local community experience. They partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Talent, IT, Security, Communications, Executive Support, and local leaders to ensure each office reflects Airbnb’s culture and values in a meaningful and scalable way. They integrate platform hosts in the day to day office experience spotlighting service and experience hosts as appropriate.

The Difference You Will Make:

As the Regional Workplace Operations Manager, you are the primary steward of the employee and guest experience within your office. You create a hospitality-forward environment where people feel welcomed, supported, and connected to Airbnb and each other.

You will oversee the daily office experience while also leading local gathering and engagement efforts that strengthen culture and community. You will direct and coordinate embedded vendors and operational partners to ensure seamless execution across hospitality, food, facilities, and events. You will provide oversight and mentorship to Office Managers within your region, ensuring consistency of standards and experience across proximate offices.

Success in this role requires strong operational ownership, exceptional interpersonal instincts, creativity, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while balancing both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

You must have your finger on the pulse and anticipate the needs of each guest.

Lead Through Hospitality

  • Maintain a visible, approachable, and highly responsive presence within the office community.
  • Create a warm, thoughtful, and highly responsive environment where employees and visitors feel genuinely welcomed and cared for.

  • Provide operational oversight and direction to on-site vendors and service partners.
  • Direct and orchestrate on-site vendors and operational vendors including food, facilities, events, and hospitality to ensure consistent service delivery and experience quality. Own escalation management and drive resolution
  • Partner closely with Security, IT and other operational teams to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.
  • Act as the “Voice of the Office,” helping employees navigate the workplace experience and ensuring the office feels connected, informed, and supported.
  • Monitor employee sentiment and proactively identify opportunities to improve the office experience, communication, and engagement.

  • Ensure the office is consistently prepared to support high-visibility visits, events, and business moments.
  • Partner with Regional Gathering Programs to support successful delivery of offsites, leadership visits and strategic gatherings.
  • Provide local stakeholder coordination, hospitality leadership, vendor management, and onsite execution support as needed.
  • Support onsite execution for local events, offsites, and engagement activities, ensuring thoughtful hospitality, operational excellence, and strong attendee experience.
  • Adapt office experiences to local needs while maintaining consistency with Airbnb culture and values.

  • Develop strong relationships with local leaders, executive admins, Airfinity groups, cross-functional partners and other key stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted partner and connector across teams, helping identify opportunities to strengthen office culture, engagement, and employee experience.
  • Partner with leaders to support meaningful moments of connection within the office and across teams.

Airbnb's mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. Our community of guests and hosts rely on Airbnb around the clock to facilitate millions of stays and experiences per day.

The Observability team builds the platform Airbnb engineers use to understand how their systems behave in production. We collect, process, store, and query metrics, logs, events, and traces from both backend services and client apps. Our metrics platform alone ingests tens of millions of samples per second across more than a billion active time series. AI agents are now consumers of this data alongside engineers: they query telemetry to write and validate code and to help debug production issues. We continue to invest in reliable and efficient real time system for both AI and human access.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Staff engineer, you will set the technical direction for a major area of the Observability platform and lead it from design through production. Problems in front of us include:

  • Scaling the metrics pipeline (OpenTelemetry, vmagent, Grafana Mimir) while controlling cost through aggregation, sampling, and blocking unused metrics.
  • Replacing legacy log aggregation with an OpenTelemetry-based pipeline, and evolving log and trace storage on OpenSearch.
  • Building a fast, reliable query layer for both engineers and AI agents, with rate limiting, access control, isolation, and caching so agent traffic does not slow down incident response.
  • Giving teams self-service visibility and control over their telemetry cost: unit cost per team and service, and controls for granularity, sampling, and retention.
  • Improving time to detect with anomaly detection and automated correlation across signals.

A Typical Day:

  • Lead the design and delivery of distributed systems that handle tens of millions of events per second, from prototype to production operation.
  • Write well-crafted, well-tested, readable, maintainable code, and contribute back to the open-source projects we run on.
  • Align roadmaps across Observability and partner infrastructure and product teams, and drive build, buy, and open-source decisions.
  • Explain tradeoffs and return on investment to engineering leadership in terms of reliability, cost, and developer productivity.
  • Mentor engineers on the team and raise the bar on design reviews, operational readiness, and on-call.
  • Help Airbnb engineers instrument their services and self-serve when debugging production issues.

Your Expertise:

  • 9+ years of industry experience, with a track record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production.
  • Led the technical direction of a system or multi-team project end to end: wrote the design, aligned stakeholders, delivered it, and operated it.
  • Deep experience in at least one telemetry domain at scale: metrics (Prometheus, Grafana Mimir, VictoriaMetrics), logs (OpenSearch, Kafka), or distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, ClickHouse).
  • Strong coding skills in Go or Java/Kotlin, and comfortable working in unfamiliar codebases, including upstream open source.
  • Experience with cloud-native infrastructure: Kubernetes, AWS, and service mesh (Istio, Envoy).
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including design docs and tradeoff analysis for engineering leadership.

Nice to Have:

  • Contributions to OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana Mimir, VictoriaMetrics, OpenSearch, Jaeger, or similar projects.
  • Experience with time series storage internals, high-cardinality data, or query performance.
  • Anomaly detection, automated correlation, or SLO-based alerting.
  • Telemetry cost attribution or cost optimization at scale.
  • Building APIs or tools for AI agents that consume operational data, such as MCP servers.
  • Columnar analytics stores such as ClickHouse.

The Community You Will Join: 

You will become a key member of the Global Operations Community Support Planning team, responsible for driving the end-to-end roadmap planning process for Community Support at Airbnb. Our team ensures that initiatives and programs are prioritized to align with our overarching strategy and our commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience. We are a global team with expertise in strategic planning, stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and organizational effectiveness.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Planning Partner, Content, you will play a critical role in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our customers through strong relationship management and strategic collaboration. You will be assigned to one or more product spaces and serve as the primary point of contact for the Content Managers, writers, and strategists in those spaces, owning the end-to-end planning and coordination of every launch that impacts Community Support content. You will ensure clear communication, alignment of objectives, and on-time, high-quality delivery of content at launch. You will proactively identify opportunities to add value while addressing potential challenges, always striving to deliver measurable impact for our customers and the business.

Your ability to build trusted relationships with content, product, engineering, marketing, and legal partners, coupled with your strategic mindset and disciplined approach to execution, will help launches go smoothly and contribute to the success of both our customers and the organization.

A Typical Day: 

  • Engage proactively with cross-functional partners and stakeholders by maintaining regular check-ins, communication of planning timelines and upcoming milestones, and feedback sessions to develop trust and ensure alignment with their goals and objectives
  • Identify all responsible individuals for each launch in advance, including the writer and strategist of the impacted content, Marketing, Legal, and technical SME approvers, Localization partners, and cross-functional partners such as taxonomy, training, resource center, Biztech, and other project managers with related work
  • Build and communicate the content schedule to all content requestors and approvers, gathering approver blockout dates and building in time for content audits, authoring, technical accuracy review, Marketing review, Legal review, localization, and a buffer for outliers
  • Schedule and lead the series of meetings for each launch: the launch info-gathering walk-through with product, engineering, and readiness; content audit sessions; a Marketing pre-flight meeting; a recurring weekly launch status meeting with the content team and technical SMEs; and a launch-day “Mission Control” meeting and Slack channel
  • Partner with strategists in content audits to identify all impacted content, prioritize impacts (P1 Day One, P2 fast-follows, P3 everything else), ensure tickets are filed for every impacted article, and flag UI-linked content and localization requirements
  • Prepare and send weekly status communications to Content Managers and content DRIs, including the list of impacted articles and P1/P2/P3 status, so that risks (audit timing, approvals behind schedule, launch date changes) are visible early
  • Anticipate risks and issues and develop mitigation strategies proactively (go beyond status reporting and drive issues to resolution), and maintain a process to capture and flag tardy content requests as “at risk”
  • Send regular reminders to DRIs with launch responsibilities and, when approvers are not responsive async, schedule live approval meetings with Marketing, Engineering, Legal, and others
  • Prepare cross-functional communications for partner teams impacted by our work, such as localization, Biztech, Knowledge Management, and Training
  • Coordinate the real-time “go live” on launch day once it has been issued by Readiness, so the content team knows it is safe to publish
  • Attend launch meetings, real-time coordination sessions, and contact center sessions organized by others to be the voice of the content team, share status, answer questions, and keep the content team informed of emerging issues
  • Shield writers from logistical questions and track down missing information, approvals, and blockers so writers can stay focused on content
  • Prepare a launch deck for leadership covering what was published and how it performed, and keep a record of published content for reporting, wins, and learnings
  • Track status and communicate on escalations after launch
  • Drive iterative improvements and simplification of content planning processes, and implement feedback mechanisms that close the loop with partners and stakeholders

  • Proven experience leading cross-functional planning or portfolio management processes with executive visibility
  • Exceptional communication skills, verbal, written and presentation, to all levels of an organization
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, understanding of system implementation, and change management
  • Proficiency in virtual collaboration and project management tools like Asana, Jira, and Airtable
  • Strategic thinking and organizational skills, with the ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally across teams
  • Hands-on, working knowledge of software product development life-cycle and methodologies. Specific experience with Agile is desired
  • Proven ability to de-escalate issues and resolve conflicts in a professional and empathetic manner

title: Partenaire principal de planification, Contenu
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

La communauté à laquelle vous vous joindrez Vous deviendrez un membre clé de l’équipe de planification du soutien à la communauté des Opérations mondiales. Cette équipe pilote le processus de planification de la feuille de route, de bout en bout, pour le soutien à la communauté d’Airbnb. Elle veille à ce que les initiatives et les programmes soient priorisés en fonction de notre stratégie globale et de notre engagement à offrir une expérience client exceptionnelle. Nous sommes une équipe mondiale experte en planification stratégique, en gestion des parties prenantes, en collaboration interfonctionnelle et en efficacité organisationnelle.

La différence que vous ferez À titre de partenaire principal de planification, Contenu, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la réussite et la satisfaction de notre clientèle grâce à une gestion des relations rigoureuse et à une collaboration stratégique. Vous soutiendrez un ou plusieurs domaines de produits et serez la personne-ressource principale des gestionnaires de contenu, des rédacteurs et rédactrices ainsi que des stratèges de ces domaines. Vous assurerez la planification et la coordination de bout en bout de chaque lancement qui a une incidence sur le contenu du soutien à la communauté. Vous veillerez à ce que la communication soit claire, que les objectifs soient harmonisés et que le contenu soit livré à temps et avec un haut niveau de qualité au moment du lancement. Vous repérerez de façon proactive les occasions d’ajouter de la valeur tout en vous attaquant aux difficultés potentielles, avec toujours en tête d’obtenir des résultats mesurables pour notre clientèle et pour l’entreprise.

Votre capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec les partenaires du contenu, du produit, de l’ingénierie, du marketing et des affaires juridiques, alliée à votre esprit stratégique et à votre rigueur d’exécution, contribuera au bon déroulement des lancements ainsi qu’à la réussite de notre clientèle et de l’organisation.

Une journée type

  • Établir un dialogue proactif avec les partenaires et les parties prenantes interfonctionnels : suivis réguliers, communication des échéanciers de planification et des jalons à venir, séances de rétroaction. Le but est de bâtir la confiance et de s’assurer de l’harmonisation avec leurs buts et objectifs.
  • Déterminer à l’avance toutes les personnes responsables de chaque lancement : le rédacteur ou la rédactrice et le ou la stratège du contenu touché; les personnes chargées d’approuver le contenu pour le marketing, les affaires juridiques et l’expertise technique; les partenaires de localisation; et les partenaires interfonctionnels, comme la taxonomie, la formation, le centre de ressources, Biztech et les autres gestionnaires de projet dont les travaux sont liés.
  • Élaborer le calendrier du contenu et le communiquer à toutes les personnes qui demandent du contenu et à celles qui l’approuvent. Pour ce faire, recueillir les dates d’indisponibilité des personnes chargées d’approuver et prévoir du temps pour les audits de contenu, la rédaction, la vérification de l’exactitude technique, la révision par le marketing, la révision juridique et la localisation, ainsi qu’une marge pour les imprévus.
  • Planifier et animer la série de réunions de chaque lancement : la séance de collecte d’information sur le lancement avec les équipes du produit, de l’ingénierie et de la préparation au lancement; les séances d’audit de contenu; une réunion préalable au lancement avec le marketing; une réunion hebdomadaire récurrente sur l’état du lancement avec l’équipe de contenu et les experts techniques; et, le jour du lancement, une réunion « Mission Control » et un canal Slack.
  • Collaborer avec les stratèges lors des audits de contenu pour repérer tout le contenu touché, en hiérarchiser les répercussions (P1 : jour du lancement; P2 : suivis à court terme; P3 : tous les autres éléments), s’assurer qu’un billet est ouvert pour chaque article touché et signaler le contenu lié à l’interface utilisateur ainsi que les exigences de localisation.
  • Préparer et envoyer chaque semaine un compte rendu de l’état d’avancement aux gestionnaires de contenu et aux personnes responsables du contenu, incluant la liste des articles touchés et leur état P1/P2/P3, afin que les risques (calendrier des audits, approbations en retard, changements de date de lancement) soient visibles rapidement.
  • Anticiper les risques et les problèmes, et élaborer de façon proactive des stratégies d’atténuation (aller au-delà du simple suivi de l’état d’avancement et mener les problèmes jusqu’à leur résolution). Maintenir un processus pour repérer les demandes de contenu tardives et les signaler comme étant « à risque ».
  • Envoyer régulièrement des rappels aux personnes ayant des responsabilités liées au lancement et, lorsque les personnes chargées d’approuver ne répondent pas en mode asynchrone, planifier des rencontres d’approbation en direct avec le marketing, l’ingénierie, les affaires juridiques et d’autres intervenants.
  • Préparer des communications interfonctionnelles à l’intention des équipes partenaires touchées par notre travail, comme la localisation, Biztech, la gestion des connaissances et la formation.
  • Coordonner en temps réel la mise en ligne le jour du lancement, une fois le feu vert donné par l’équipe de préparation au lancement, afin que l’équipe de contenu sache qu’elle peut publier en toute sécurité.
  • Participer aux réunions de lancement, aux séances de coordination en temps réel et aux séances du centre de contact organisées par d’autres équipes afin d’être la voix de l’équipe de contenu, de faire le point, de répondre aux questions et de tenir l’équipe de contenu informée des problèmes émergents.
  • Épargner aux rédacteurs et rédactrices les questions logistiques, obtenir les renseignements et les approbations manquants et lever les obstacles, afin de leur permettre de se consacrer au contenu.
  • Préparer à l’intention de la direction une bilan de lancement qui décrit ce qui a été publié et le rendement du contenu, et tenir un registre du contenu publié pour alimenter les rapports, mettre en valeur les réussites et documenter les leçons apprises.
  • Suivre l’état des dossiers transmis à un palier supérieur après le lancement et en rendre compte.
  • Favoriser l’amélioration continue et la simplification des processus de planification du contenu, et mettre en place des mécanismes de rétroaction qui permettent de communiquer les suites données aux partenaires et aux parties prenantes.

Votre expertise

  • Au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans des postes de planification stratégique, de gestion de programmes ou d’opérations d’affaires, avec des réussites démontrées.
  • Expérience avérée du pilotage de processus de planification interfonctionnelle ou de gestion de portefeuille, avec une exposition à la haute direction.
  • Compétences exceptionnelles en communication (orale, écrite et présentations) auprès de tous les niveaux d’une organisation.
  • Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension de la mise en œuvre de systèmes et de la gestion du changement.
  • Maîtrise des outils de collaboration à distance et de gestion de projet, comme Asana, Jira et Airtable.
  • Esprit stratégique et sens de l’organisation, et capacité de travailler en collaboration avec différentes équipes.
  • Connaissance pratique du cycle de vie et des méthodologies de développement de produits logiciels. Une expérience concrète de la méthodologie Agile est un atout.
  • Capacité éprouvée à désamorcer les situations tendues et à résoudre les conflits de façon professionnelle et empathique.
  • Capacité de gérer simultanément plusieurs lancements et priorités concurrentes, tout en veillant à ce que les livrables soient remis à temps et dans le respect de la portée du projet.
  • Aisance à composer avec des priorités changeantes et capacité de proposer des solutions dans un environnement dynamique, ambigu et au rythme soutenu.
  • Expérience de la planification ou de la coordination de lancements de contenu, de gestion des connaissances ou de produits.

Votre emplacement :

En raison de la nature de ce poste, le candidat retenu devra être basé au Canada pour pouvoir effectuer son travail. Actuellement, les employés peuvent être situés dans : la Colombie-Britannique, l'Ontario, le Québec, l'Alberta ou le Saskatchewan. Cette liste est continuellement mise à jour, veuillez vérifier avec nous si les provinces dans lesquelles vous vivez figurent sur la liste. Si votre poste est employé par une autre entité Airbnb, votre recruteur vous informera des provinces dans lesquelles vous êtes éligible pour travailler.

Notre engagement envers l’inclusion et l’appartenance :

Airbnb s'engage à travailler avec le vivier de talents le plus large possible. Nous pensons que la diversité des idées favorise l’innovation et l’engagement, et nous permet d’attirer des personnes créatives et de développer les meilleurs produits, services et solutions. Toutes les personnes qualifiées sont encouragées à postuler.

Nous nous efforçons également de proposer un processus de candidature et d'entretien inclusif pour les personnes handicapées. Si vous êtes un candidat handicapé et avez besoin d'aménagements raisonnables pour soumettre une candidature, veuillez nous contacter à l'adresse : raisonnableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Veuillez inclure votre nom complet, le poste pour lequel vous postulez et les aménagements nécessaires pour vous aider dans le processus de recrutement. 

Nous vous demandons de nous contacter uniquement si vous êtes un candidat dont le handicap vous empêche de remplir notre candidature en ligne.

Nous utilisons des outils automatisés pour aider notre équipe de recrutement à examiner efficacement un grand nombre de candidatures. Toutes les décisions finales d’embauche sont prises par une personne humaine.

Ce poste correspond à un poste vacant au sein de l'organisation.

The Community You Will Join

The Experimentation team's mission is to provide an insightful, reliable and easy to use experimentation platform (A/B testing and feature rollout) for customers across the company. Thousands of experiments run on our platform each year. Our team is multidisciplinary, owning a vertical stack that includes UIs for setting up and analyzing experiments, data pipelines and libraries for calculating results, and the clients and services that deliver feature flags, product configuration and experiment assignment to applications. You will work closely with data science partners, engineers across infrastructure teams, and the product engineers who use our tools every day.

The Difference You Will Make

You will co-own the client libraries and services that thousands of Airbnb engineers use to roll out features and run experiments, primarily on the JVM, alongside the engineer who owns them today. You will help consolidate our feature flag and product configuration systems onto a single platform and make it easy and safe to set up flags, configuration and experiments in code. Success looks like clients that are fast, reliable and easy to adopt, large cross-team migrations that finish on schedule without breaking consumers, and new assignment capabilities that meet Airbnb's needs.

A Typical Day

  • Build and extend the capabilities of our experimentation, feature flagging and product configuration clients and the services behind them.
  • Design and lead cross-team migrations: evolving client APIs, deprecating old ones, and moving consuming services over safely.
  • Improve the testability, performance and reliability of client libraries that are widely deployed and tightly interconnected.
  • Build new allocation and targeting capabilities in partnership with data science, such as holdouts and mutually exclusive experiments, with attention to statistical pitfalls.
